blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Wanda ( Sun et al., 2024 ) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda , which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection—keys for query weights, and queries for key weights—allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B–72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on the model. At 80% sparsity on Llama 2 70B, WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity decrease by 20.3% and 13.5%, while mean zero-shot accuracy rises by 5.94 percentage points. Qwen2.5-72B also improves, but Llama-3.1-70B has substantially higher perplexity despite lower reconstruction error. These results show both the promise of coupled pruning criteria and the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of model quality.
blocks.zh: Wanda(Sun等人,2024年)通过在每个线性投影中独立评分权重来推波助澜大型语言模型,尽管查询和键通过点产品相互作用. 我们介绍QK-Wanda, 以他们个人的删除成本来评分, 它增加了万达的得分,从相反的预测中获得了信息——用于查询权重的钥匙,以及用于查询关键权重的钥匙——使两个预测都能够共享一个耗尽的预算。 它的闭式分数不需要梯度或重量更新;全推速比A100上的万达长1.3%,H200上的长3.1%,与我们的主要实验中使用的校准值相同. 我们只评价来自TinyLlama、Llama 2、Llama 3和Quen2.5的15种模式, 相对于万达,QK-万达将QK重建误差平均减少60%,在50%的垃圾堆中减少45%,在80%. 下游收益取决于模型. 在Llama 2 70B上,WikiText-2和C4的棱率分别下降了20.3%和13.5%,而零射精度则上升了5.94个百分点. 文2.5-72B号 也有改进,但Llama-3.1-70B尽管重建错误较小,但难度却大得多。 这些结果显示,有可能同时制定标准,而且当地重建作为模型质量的预测者也有限度。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) perform well across language understanding, generation, and reasoning tasks, but storing and running their billions of parameters remains expensive ( Touvron et al., 2023 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Qwen et al., 2024 ) . Model compression addresses this cost. Quantization reduces the bits per weight; pruning sets selected weights to zero. Both seek to preserve predictive quality. We focus on unstructured pruning ( Hoefler et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)在语言理解、生成和推理任务方面表现良好,但其数十亿参数的存储和运行仍然昂贵(Touvron等人,2023年;Grattafiori等人,2024年;Quen等人,2024年)。 模型压缩可以解决这个成本. 量子化可以将比特/重量减少;普鲁因将选定的重量设定为零. 两者都力求保持预测质量。 我们专注于无结构化的挤压(Hoefler等人,2021年).

blocks.en: Wanda selects weights using their magnitudes and calibration activations, without updating retained weights ( Sun et al., 2024 ) . We focus on this mask-only setting, rather than methods that also compensate for pruning errors, such as SparseGPT and Thanos ( Frantar & Alistarh, 2023 ; Ilin & Richtárik, 2025 ) . Our question is whether accounting for query–key interactions can improve these scalar pruning decisions.
blocks.zh: 万达使用其体积和校准激活来选择权重,而不更新保留权重(Sun等人,2024年). 我们专注于这个只戴面具的设定,而不是那些同样可以弥补打磨错误的方法,如SparseGPT和Thanos(Frantar & Alistarh, 2023; Ilin & Richtárik, 2025). 我们的问题是,盘问-键相互作用的核算是否能够改善这些刻度计算的决定。

blocks.en: Wanda measures each deletion through its effect on an individual projection. In attention, however, a query perturbation changes dot products according to the keys it interacts with, and vice versa ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . QK-Wanda therefore scores deletions using a common reconstruction objective for all query–key products ( Equation 6 ). The resulting query and key scores measure changes to the same objective, allowing a fixed pruning budget to be allocated across rows and between the two projections.
blocks.zh: 万达通过对单个投影的影响对每次删除进行测量. 然而,在注意时,一个查询扰动会根据其与键的相互作用而改变点产品,反之亦然(Vaswani等人,2017年)。 因此,QK-Wanda对所有查询-关键产品使用共同的重建目标对删除进行评分(方程式6 )。 由此产生的查询和关键分数衡量了同一目标的变化,从而可以跨行和两个预测之间分配固定的循环预算。

blocks.en: QK-Wanda changes only how query and key weights are scored, so this paper focuses on pruning query and key weights. Unless stated otherwise, all other weights stay dense and sparsity refers to the query and key weights alone. Across our checkpoints, these weights make up 6–17% of the linear-layer weights in a transformer block and 4–16% of all parameters (Appendix E.4 ). The remaining projections can still be pruned with Wanda; Section 4.5 evaluates this broader pruning scope.
blocks.zh: QK-万达只改变查询和密钥权重的得分方式,因此本文着重探讨查询和密钥权重. 除非另有说明,所有其他重量都保持密度,而痉挛只指查询和关键重量。 通过我们的检查站,这些重量占变压器区块线性层重量的6-17 %,占所有参数的4-16 %(附录E.4)。 其余的预测仍可与万达一起进行;第4.5节评价了这一更广泛的预测范围。

blocks.en: 1. We derive closed-form scalar deletion costs from the QK reconstruction objective, including grouped-query attention and retained biases ( Equation 7 ). These exact individual costs define an additive mask-selection surrogate and allow query and key weights to share a pruning budget without gradients or updates to retained weights. 2. Across 15 checkpoints, we evaluate full QK reconstruction, perplexity, and zero-shot accuracy. The results show gains on models from the Llama 2 and Qwen2.5 families, alongside model- and metric-dependent outcomes on Llama 3. 3. We investigate variations of the QK reconstruction score incorporating causal masking, rotary position embeddings, and row centering of QK products. Combining these three choices gives eight variants, which we evaluate on six checkpoints at 50% and 80% QK sparsity. The extensions offer improvements in selected configurations, but no consistent downstream advantage over the base score (Appendix P ).
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 我们从 " QK " 重建目标中得出封闭式的删除费用,包括分组式关注和保留偏差(方程式7 )。 这些精确的单个成本定义了一个添加剂的面具选择代位,并允许查询和密钥权重共享一个奔跑的预算,而无需梯度或更新保留权重. 2. 在15个检查站中,我们评价了全面QK重建、迷惑性和零射精度。 结果显示,Llama 2和Quen2.5家庭在模型方面有所收获,Llama 3的模型和衡量结果也有所进步。 3. 我们调查QK重建分数的变化,包括因果蒙面、旋转位置嵌入和排在QK产品的中心。 将这三种选择结合起来,有8种变体,我们对6个检查站的评价为50%和80%的QK垃圾。 扩展提供了对所选配置的改进,但相对于基准分数(Appendix P.),下游没有一致的优势.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: Optimal Brain Damage uses diagonal second-order loss sensitivity; Optimal Brain Surgeon includes compensating weight changes ( LeCun et al., 1989 ; Hassibi & Stork, 1992 ) . Optimal Brain Compression develops layer-reconstruction methods for pruning and quantization ( Frantar et al., 2022 ) . SparseGPT scales compensated pruning to LLMs, while Thanos solves for several deletions within a weight block together and adapts their allocation ( Frantar & Alistarh, 2023 ; Ilin & Richtárik, 2025 ) . We study mask selection with surviving weights fixed.
blocks.zh: 最佳脑损伤采用对角二阶损失敏感性;最佳脑外科手术包括补偿重量变化(LeCun等人,1989年;Hassibi & Stork,1992年)。 优化大脑压缩开发层重建方法,用于挤压和定量(Frantar等人,2022年). SparseGPT比例表补偿了对LLMs的挤压,而Thanos在一个重量块内解决了多个删除,并调整了它们的分配(Frantar & Alistarh, 2023; Ilin & Richtárik, 2025). 我们用固定的存活重量来研究面具选择

blocks.en: Wanda ranks weights by their magnitudes and input activation norms ( Sun et al., 2024 ) . We recall its interpretation as the exact reconstruction cost of deleting a single weight while keeping all others fixed.

Only output row i i changes, by ( O ^ − O ) i : = − W i ​ j X j : (\widehat{O}-O)_{i:}=-W_{ij}X_{j:} . Its squared reconstruction error gives Wanda’s score in squared form: S i ​ j W = ‖ − W i ​ j X j : ‖ 2 2 = W i ​ j 2 ‖ X j : ‖ 2 2 , S^{W}_{ij}=\left\lVert-W_{ij}X_{j:}\right\rVert_{2}^{2}=W_{ij}^{2}\left\lVert X_{j:}\right\rVert_{2}^{2}, (1) where ‖ ⋅ ‖ 2 \left\lVert\cdot\right\rVert_{2} is the Euclidean norm and the superscript W W labels Wanda. Squaring its original nonnegative score preserves the ranking. Selecting the smallest score solves the single-deletion reconstruction problem exactly. For multiple deletions, their effects can interact, so individual deletion costs do not generally add up to the joint reconstruction loss. Wanda uses these costs greedily, removing the lowest-scoring weights within each output row until its pruning budget is met. With fixed inputs, deleting one weight leaves the Wanda scores of the remaining weights unchanged.

RIA combines relative weight importance with activations and uses channel permutation for N:M sparsity ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) . SymWanda adds input- and output-side reconstruction terms for a single matrix ( Yi & Richtárik, 2025 ) . Our objective instead couples QK projections through their output dot products over all token pairs, making their deletion costs comparable.

blocks.en: ThinK prunes key-cache channels using query-dependent contribution norms ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Its full-sequence channel criterion is the product of the norms of the corresponding query and key channels; its implementation uses a recent query window. This anticipates the opposite-projection energy principle, but removes cache channels rather than scalar projection weights. CORP ranks matched QK dimensions by expected contribution energy and applies closed-form compensation ( Zhang & Yang, 2026 ) . SNP selects paired QK neurons using singular components of attention scores ( Shim et al., 2024 ) , while SparseLoRA uses a QK norm criterion for channel selection during fine-tuning ( Khaki et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: ThinK prunes key-cache通道使用依赖查询的贡献规范(徐等人,2025年). 其全序通道标准是对应查询和关键通道规范的产物;其执行使用近代查询窗口. 这预示着反投影能量原理,但会去掉缓存通道,而不是斜拉投影权重. CORP排名以预期贡献能量与QK维度相匹配,并适用封闭式补偿(Zhang & Yang, 2026). SNP使用注意力分数的单数成分选择配对的QK神经元(Shim等人,2024年),而Sparse LoRA在微调时使用QK规范标准选择通道(Khaki等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Other approaches change the representation or reconstruction target. Liang et al. (2025) optimize masks through nonlinear attention reconstruction, including separate QK masks in their LLM experiment. We evaluate closed-form deletions under an unmasked pre-RoPE objective. CLOVER prunes orthogonal directions, A 3 A^{3} derives low-rank attention approximations, and RAP removes RoPE-aligned channel pairs for KV-cache compression ( Meng et al., 2025 ; Wong et al., 2026 ; Xin et al., 2026 ) . LLM-Pruner , SliceGPT , and FASP provide broader structural alternatives; DIMAP develops a data-independent module-aware criterion for vision transformers ( Ma et al., 2023 ; Ashkboos et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; He & Zhou, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 其他办法改变了代表性或重建目标。 梁等人(2025年)通过非线性注意力重建优化口罩,包括在他们的LLM实验中单独使用QK口罩. 我们评价封闭式的删除 在一个不露面的 RoPE前目标。 CLOVER prunes orthogonal direction, A 3 A^{3} 获得低排名的注意近似, RAP删除了用于KV-cache压缩的ROPE对通道(Meng等人,2025年;Wong等人,2026年;Xin等人,2026年). LLM-Pruner, SliiceGPT, FASP提供了更广泛的结构替代品;DIMAP为视变器开发了一个数据独立的模块-意识标准(Ma等人,2023年;Ashkboos等人,2024年;Hu等人,2025年;He&Zhou,2024年)。

blocks.en: Wanda++ uses regional gradients and decoder-block optimization ( Yang et al., 2025 ) ; SparseLLM coordinates global pruning subproblems ( Bai et al., 2024 ) . SNOWS optimizes deeper nonlinear representations and readjusts retained weights in vision networks ( Lucas & Mazumder, 2025 ) . Our experiments isolate forward-only QK mask selection with surviving weights fixed; they do not establish superiority over these broader optimization procedures.
blocks.zh: Wanda++使用区域梯度和解码器-块优化(Yang等人,2025年);SparseLLM协调全球普润子问题(Bai等人,2024年). SNOWS优化了更深层的非线性表示,重新调整在视觉网络中保留了权重(Lucas & Mazumder, 2025) . 我们的实验用固定的存活重量来隔离前置的QK口罩选择;它们并没有建立优于这些更广泛的优化程序.

blocks.en: OWL studies nonuniform layerwise sparsity ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , while Ji et al. (2025) examine sensitivity to calibration data. We study budget allocation between Q and K within a block and vary calibration size and sequence length. Causal masking, shared key heads, and rotary positions affect which QK interactions a score measures ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Ainslie et al., 2023 ; Su et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: OWL研究非单体层螺旋(Yin等人,2024年),而Ji等人研究. (2025)考察校准数据的敏感性. 我们在一个区块内研究Q和K之间的预算分配,并不同校准大小和序列长度. Causal masking, 共享关键头,以及旋转姿势影响QK相互作用的计分措施(Vaswani等人,2017年;Ainslie等人,2023年;Su等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Other quantization approaches reconstruct individual layers or optimize compressed representations, including GPTQ , AQLM , PV-Tuning , HIGGS , and QTIP ( Frantar et al., 2023 ; Egiazarian et al., 2024 ; Malinovskii et al., 2024 ; Malinovskii et al., 2025 ; Tseng et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 其他量化方法重建各层或优化压缩表示,包括GPTQ、AQLM、PV-Tuning、HIGGS和QTIP(Frantar等人,2023年;Egiazarian等人,2024年;Malinovskii等人,2024年;Malinovskii等人,2025年;Tseng等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: 3 QK-Wanda
blocks.zh: 3 QK-旺达

blocks.en: QK-Wanda follows the same single-deletion principle as Wanda, but reconstructs query–key products instead of each projection separately. We first derive the exact cost of deleting one weight while leaving all others fixed, then use these costs greedily to select weights under separate or shared QK budgets. The derivation starts with an unmasked single-head example before extending the same objective to shared key heads.
blocks.zh: QK-Wanda遵循与Wanda相同的单删除原则,但重建查询-键产品,而不是分别进行每个投影. 我们首先得出删除一个重量而将所有其他重量固定的确切成本,然后用这些成本贪婪地在单独的或共享的QK预算下选择权重. 推论首先从一个未装模作样的单头例子开始,然后将同一目标延伸至共享的关键头.

blocks.en: 3.1 Single-head derivation: unmasked QK reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.1 单头衍生:未装潢的QK重建

blocks.en: We work within one fixed transformer block. First consider one query head and its own key head, as in ordinary multi-head attention (MHA), using one calibration sequence and omitting the causal mask. This unmasked, pre-RoPE case, QK-Wanda , makes the coupling especially simple: a query weight matters through the keys, and a key weight through the queries. Section 3.2 extends the same objective to several query heads sharing a key head, as in grouped-query attention (GQA).

For a nonzero opposite-projection activation row, this leaves the ranking unchanged, so identical row budgets and tie-breaking rules produce identical pruning masks. The additional factor therefore affects comparisons across rows and between Q and K. Causal weighting and averaging over independent sequences can also change within-row rankings; Appendix B.4 gives examples and the zero-energy exception.

blocks.en: 3.2 Extension to grouped-query attention
blocks.zh: 3.2 扩展至分组式注意

blocks.en: We now extend the same unmasked reconstruction objective ( 3 ) to grouped-query attention (GQA), where several query heads share one key head. GQA reduces KV-cache memory and bandwidth during decoding ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) . For example, Llama 3.1-8B uses 32 query heads and 8 key/value heads, so each group of four query heads shares one key head and one value head ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们现在将同样的无假象重建目标(3)延伸至分组式关注(GQA),几个查询头有一个关键头。 GQA在解码过程中减少KV-cache内存和带宽(Ainslie等人,2023年). 例如,Llama 3.1-8B使用32个查询头和8个键/值头,因此每组4个查询头共用一个键头和一个值头(Grattafiori等人,2024年).

blocks.en: 3.3 Mask construction and computational cost
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 遮盖施工和计算费用

blocks.en: In the single-sequence setting of Section 3.1 , Wanda and QK-Wanda produce identical pruning masks under the same row budgets and tie-breaking rules, provided the opposite-projection factors are nonzero. The additional QK factor only rescales scores within each row, so we relax the row quotas to let it affect which weights are removed. We therefore select weights across each projection matrix independently ( separate QK budgets ) or across both projections together (a shared QK budget ), as illustrated in Figure 2 . The shared allocation is meaningful because Q and K scores measure changes to the same reconstruction loss ( 6 ).
blocks.zh: 在第3.1节的单序列设定中,万达和QK-万达在同一行预算和打结规则下生产相同的冲刷口罩,条件是相反投影系数为非零。 附加的QK因子只在每行内调整分数,所以我们放松行配额,让其影响去除哪些权重. 因此,如图2所示,我们独立选择每个预测矩阵的权重(单列的QK预算)或两个预测的权重(共享的QK预算)。 共享分配是有意义的,因为Q和K的分数衡量相同的重建损失的变化(6 )。

blocks.en: To distinguish the effect of QK-aware scoring from that of relaxing row quotas, Figure 2 also includes Wanda with a matrix-wide budget for each projection, matching the separate QK-Wanda allocation. Wanda scores measure reconstruction errors of the Q and K projections separately; their relative scale is not calibrated to a common QK reconstruction objective. We therefore use separate matrix budgets for this control rather than pooling Wanda scores into a shared QK budget.
blocks.zh: 为了区分QK-aware评分与放松行配额的效果,图2还包括了Wanda,每个预测都有矩阵全预算,匹配了单独的QK-Wanda分配. 万达分数分别衡量Q和K预测的重建错误;其相对尺度不适应一个共同的QK重建目标. 因此,我们使用单独的矩阵预算来进行这种控制,而不是将万达的得分并入一个共享的QK预算.

blocks.en: QK-Wanda scores ( 5 , 7 ) share a common scale because they measure deletion costs under the same QK reconstruction loss. Multiplying either entire projection, including its weights and bias, by a nonzero constant a a , while holding the other fixed, multiplies both query and key scores by a 2 a^{2} . Their relative scale and the ranking in a shared QK pool therefore stay unchanged. Wanda’s squared scores scale by a 2 a^{2} only for the rescaled projection; the other projection’s scores stay unchanged. Pooling Wanda scores would thus require a choice of relative scaling between projections, whereas QK-Wanda needs no such calibration.
blocks.zh: QK-万达分数(5,7)共用一个比分,因为它们在相同的QK重建损失下测量删除成本. 将整个投影(包括其重量和偏差)乘以一个非零常数 a,同时持有另一个固定的,将查询和密钥分数乘以2 a^{2}。 因此,它们的相对规模和在共享QK池中的排名保持不变。 旺达的平方分数只有2a================ 因此,汇集旺达分数将需要在预测之间作出相对的衡量选择,而QK旺达则不需要这种校准。

blocks.en: Let D Q = H Q ​ m D_{Q}=H_{Q}m and D K = H K ​ m D_{K}=H_{K}m be the total query and key widths. For N N calibration sequences of length T T , a forward pass through the QK projections costs O ⁡ ( N ​ T ​ d ​ ( D Q + D K ) ) O(NTd(D_{Q}+D_{K})) . The QK scores require only per-sequence input and head-coordinate energies, costing O ⁡ ( N ​ T ​ ( d + D Q + D K ) ) O(NT(d+D_{Q}+D_{K})) to accumulate. Combining these energies across sequences costs O ⁡ ( N ​ d ​ D K ) O(NdD_{K}) , with query-side factors reused by heads sharing a key; applying the factors to all weights costs O ⁡ ( d ⁡ ( D Q + D K ) ) O(d(D_{Q}+D_{K})) . These additional terms do not change the asymptotic order of QK projection and scoring. Stable mask selection additionally sorts P = d ⁡ ( D Q + D K ) P=d(D_{Q}+D_{K}) scores, with O ⁡ ( P ​ log ⁡ P ) O(P\log P) comparison-sort complexity for a shared pool. No T × T T\times T product matrix, gradients, or updates to retained weights are needed.

blocks.en: To measure the practical overhead, we benchmark Wanda and QK-Wanda across four Llama 3 model sizes on A100 and H200 GPUs using the same 524,288 calibration tokens, sequence length 64, and batch size 32 as the main experiments. We include calibration forwards, scoring, GPU mask selection, weight zeroing and propagation through the pruned blocks. QK-Wanda takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on average on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200. Table 1 reports the H200 measurements; Appendix M gives results for both GPUs and the timing protocol.
blocks.zh: 为了测量实际的间接费用,我们把万达和QK-万达在A100和H200GPU上的四个Llama 3模型尺寸作为基准,使用相同的524,288校准符,序列长度64,以及批量尺寸32作为主要实验. 我们包括校准前方、评分、GPU面具选择、重量零化和通过铺设的块传播。 QK-万达在A100平均比万达长1.3%,H200平均长3.1%. 表1报告了H200的测量结果;附录M提供了GPU和计时协议的结果。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Our experiments test whether preserving local QK products also preserves the quality of the complete pruned model. We compare reconstruction error, perplexity, and zero-shot accuracy across checkpoints, and use controlled ablations to distinguish the effects of scoring and budget allocation.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验测试了保存当地QK产品是否也保存了完整的被磨损模型的质量. 我们比较各检查站的重建错误、迷惑和零射线准确性,并使用有控制的擦伤来区分评分和预算拨款的影响。

blocks.en: Figure 2: QK-only pruning of Llama-2-70B. Left and center: WikiText-2 PPL at low and high sparsity. Right: mean relative QK reconstruction error ( Equation 49 ). Matrix-budget Wanda and separate-budget QK-Wanda remove the same number of weights from each projection. C4 results: Figure 34 ; additional model curves: Appendices I and J .
blocks.zh: 图2:仅限QK的拉玛-2-70B的普鲁士. 左侧和中侧:维基Text-2 PPL 低度和高度的sparsity. 右:指相对的QK重建错误(方程式49 ). 矩阵预算Wanda和单独预算QK-Wanda从每个预测中去除相同数量的权重. C4结果: 图34; 其他模型曲线: 附录一和J。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We evaluated 15 base checkpoints: TinyLlama-1.1B; Llama-2-7B/13B/70B; Llama-3.2-1B/3B and Llama-3.1-8B/70B; and Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B/14B/32B/72B ( Zhang et al., 2024a ; Touvron et al., 2023 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Meta AI, 2024 ; Qwen et al., 2024 ) . Llama-2-7B/13B use multi-head attention (MHA); the other checkpoints use grouped-query attention (GQA). Unless stated otherwise, sparsity refers only to W Q , W K W^{Q},W^{K} ; all other parameters remain dense. QK weights comprise 4.46–16.11% of total model parameters across these checkpoints, so 50% QK sparsity removes 2.23–8.06% of the total (Appendix E.4 ). Our main tables compare row-wise Wanda with QK-Wanda , which shares a pruning budget between query and key weights in each block. The curves additionally show QK-Wanda with a separate budget for each projection. On the three largest checkpoints, we also tested Wanda with a separate matrix-wide budget for each projection. All methods used sequential, one-shot unstructured pruning without retraining or survivor updates; biases and the original attention computation remained fixed. Integer budgets and reproducibility details are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了15个基地检查站:TinyLlama-1.1B;Llama-2-7B/13B/70B;Llama-32-1B/3B和Llama-31-8B/70B;和Quen2.5 0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B/14B/32B/72B(张等人,2024a;Touvron等人,2023;Grattafiori等人,2024;Meta AI,2024;Quen等人,2024);Llama-2-7B/13B使用多头注意(MHA);其他检查站使用分组注意(GQA)。 除非另有说明,sparsity只指W Q,W K ^{Q},W^{K};所有其他参数仍然密集. QK权重占这些检查站模型总参数的4.46至16.11%,因此,50%的QK垃圾屑消除了总量的2.23至8.06%(附录E.4)。 我们的主要表格将Wanda和QK-Wanda进行逐行比较,后者在每个区块的查询和关键权重之间共享一个奔跑的预算. 曲线还显示QK-万达,每个预测都有单独的预算. 在三个最大的检查站,我们还对万达进行了测试,为每项预测分别编列了总预算。 所有方法都采用相继进行、一发无结构的扫射,而没有再培训或幸存者更新;偏见和最初的注意力计算保持不变。 合并预算和可复制性细节见附录E。

blocks.en: The main comparisons used calibration seed 0 and 524,288 C4 training tokens ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) : 256 windows of length 2048, segmented into 8192 independent sequences of length 64. We chose this configuration based on the calibration-sensitivity studies in Appendix F . Increasing the number of windows beyond 256 brought negligible PPL improvements for both Wanda and QK-Wanda. With the total token count fixed, we then tested different sequence lengths on Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-2-7B. Length 64 gave the lowest PPL on Llama-3.1-8B and nearly matched the minima at length 128 on Llama-2-7B, with differences no larger than 0.001 PPL. These small differences across lengths and consistent results across the two model families supported using 256 base windows segmented into length-64 sequences as our common calibration setting. Each checkpoint used its native tokenizer and identical sampled tokens across methods and sparsities. We used FP16 weights except for Qwen2.5-72B, whose dense and pruned models used BF16 to avoid nonfinite FP16 activations. Hardware and software details are in Appendix E.5 .
blocks.zh: 主比较使用校准种子0和524,288 C4训练符号(Raffel等人,2020年):256个窗口,长度2048,分为8192个独立的序列,长度64. 我们根据附录F中的校准敏感性研究选择了这种配置。 为万达和QK-万达增加的窗户数量超过256个,使PPL改进可忽略不计。 随着总令牌计数的固定,我们随后在Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-2-7B上测试了不同的序列长度. 长度64给出了Llama-3.1-8B上最低的PPL,几乎与Llama-2-7B上128长度的迷你药匹配,其差异不超过0.001 PPL. 不同长度的这些小差异和两个模型家庭的一致结果,作为我们共同的校准设置,利用256个基窗被分割成64个长度序列。 每个检查站都使用其本地的代号器和相同的抽样代号。 我们除了Quen2.5-72B外,还使用了FP16重量,其密集和繁忙的模型利用BF16来避免非无限FP16激活. 硬件和软件细节见附录E.5。

blocks.en: We evaluate pruning at two levels. Held-out QK reconstruction error measures how well each block preserves QK products on the same dense-model inputs. Perplexity on WikiText-2 ( Merity et al., 2017 ) and C4 and mean accuracy across seven zero-shot tasks measure the quality of the complete pruned model. Comparing these metrics tests whether better local reconstruction translates into downstream gains.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个层面来评估运行情况。 Hold-out QK重建错误测量每个块如何在相同的密集型输入上保存QK产品. 在WikiText-2(Merity等人,2017年)和C4上的迷惑度,以及7个零镜头任务的平均精度度,测量了完全被碾压的模型的质量. 比较这些衡量标准,可以检验当地重建的改善是否转化为下游收益。

blocks.en: We measure QK reconstruction error on 16 held-out C4 sequences of length 512 and average it across blocks ( Equation 49 ). This diagnostic differs from pruning calibration, where later blocks receive method-specific sparse-network inputs. A block’s 1% relative squared error corresponds to 10% relative Frobenius-norm error; the reported average over blocks is taken before any square root. We measured WikiText-2 test and C4 validation PPL at context 2048 over 0–90% sparsity in 10-point steps. At 30%, 50%, and 80%, we also evaluated saved masks on seven zero-shot tasks, reporting their unweighted mean accuracy with LM Evaluation Harness ( EleutherAI, 2026 ) ; tasks, splits, and metrics are specified in Appendix E.2 . Dense references are shared within each checkpoint. All differences, relative reductions, counts, and bold marks use unrounded measurements; values that tie at the displayed precision can differ in the source data. The 15-model counts compare shared QK-Wanda against original row-wise Wanda, excluding dense points: 135 checkpoint–sparsity pairs per PPL/error metric and 45 for mean accuracy. They describe one calibration seed, not independent statistical trials or statistically significant wins.
blocks.zh: 我们测量了16个悬浮的C4序列的QK重建错误,长度为512,并平均跨区块(第49条方程式)。 这种诊断方法与普鲁因校准方法不同,后来的区块会得到特定方法的稀疏网络输入. 区块的1%相对平方误差相当于10%相对的Frobenius-norm误差;报告的区块平均误差在任何平方根之前。 我们在2048年上下文中测量了WikiText-2测试和C4验证PPL,在10点的步数中超过0-90%的螺纹。 在30%、50%和80%的情况下,我们还评估了七个零镜头任务中保存的口罩,报告它们未加权的平均准确度为LM评价Harness(EleutherAI,2026年);任务、拆分和衡量标准在附录E.2中作了规定。 每个检查站都共享大量参考资料。 所有差异,相对减少,计数,以及粗体标记都使用未圆形的测量;在显示精度时绑定的值在源数据上可能有所不同. 15模式的计数将共享的QK-万达与原排位法的万达进行比较,不包括密集点:每PPL/error度量衡135个检查站-平准对,平均精度45个. 它们描述了一个校准种子,而不是独立的统计试验或统计上重要的胜利.

blocks.en: Table 2: QK-only pruning of the largest checkpoints: WikiText-2/C4 PPL ( ↓ \downarrow ), seven-task mean zero-shot accuracy ( ↑ \uparrow ), and QK reconstruction error ( ↓ \downarrow ). Accuracy and error are percentages. Wanda uses row budgets, Wanda (matrix) separate projection budgets, and both QK-Wanda variants shared budgets. Bold marks the best result at each sparsity, using unrounded values. Full model and task results appear in Appendices G , H , and N .
blocks.zh: 表2:仅限QK运行最大检查站:WikiText-2/C4 PPL(QQ\downarrow),7任务表示0射精度(QQ\uparrow),QK重建错误(QQ\downarrow). 准确性和误差是百分比。 万达使用行预算,万达(matrix)单独预测预算,以及QK-万达两种变体共用预算. 粗体标记每个垃圾场的最佳结果,使用未四舍五入的值。 完整的模型和任务结果载于附录G、H和N。

blocks.en: 4.2 Largest checkpoints across model families
blocks.zh: 4.2 模范家庭之间最大的检查站

blocks.en: At 80% QK sparsity, QK-Wanda substantially narrows the quality gap to the dense Llama-2-70B model ( Table 2 ). WikiText-2/C4 PPL improves from 4.55/6.91 with Wanda to 3.63/5.97, compared with 3.32/5.71 for the dense checkpoint. Mean zero-shot accuracy rises from 65.85% to 71.79%, slightly above the dense reference of 71.50%; we do not establish a statistically significant improvement over dense. Qwen2.5-72B also improves on both PPL metrics and mean accuracy. Llama-3.1-70B shows the limitation: QK error decreases from 5.27% to 3.27%, but PPL increases from 4.98/9.89 to 18.89/32.59. Mean zero-shot accuracy, however, changes from 66.64% with Wanda to 65.93% with QK-Wanda, a decrease of 0.71 percentage points. Thus, the large PPL increase is not accompanied by a comparably large drop in this seven-task mean; this does not imply equivalent performance on individual tasks or other downstream uses.

blocks.en: Table 2 also includes shared-budget QK-Wanda-MRC , which combines causal masking, RoPE, and centering (explained in Appendices B.1 , C.2 , and O , respectively). At 80% on Llama-3.1-70B, it reduces WikiText-2/C4 PPL from 18.89/32.59 to 13.67/22.61 relative to the base score, but remains worse than Wanda and decreases mean accuracy from 65.93% to 62.61%. Also at 80%, the base score has lower PPL and higher accuracy on Llama-2-70B, while Qwen2.5-72B has mixed PPL ordering. MRC therefore offers a checkpoint-specific improvement rather than a uniform replacement. Appendix P compares all eight combinations.
blocks.zh: 表2中还包括了共享预算QK-Wanda-MRC,该预算将因果遮罩、RoPE和中心(分别载于附录B.1、C.2和O)结合起来。 在Llama-3.1-70B上为80%,比基数降低18.89/32.59的Wikitext-2/C4 PPL,但仍比万达差,平均精度从65.93%降至62.61%. 同样在80%时,基分在Llama-2-70B上有较低的PPL和更高的精度,而Quen2.5-72B则有混合的PPL订购. 因此,核管制委员会提供针对检查站的改进,而不是统一的更换。 附 录 P比较所有8种组合.

blocks.en: Relaxing Wanda’s row quotas has a checkpoint-dependent effect. At 80%, matrix budgets lower both PPL metrics on Llama-2-70B and Qwen2.5-72B, but worsen them on Llama-3.1-70B ( Table 2 ). Comparing matrix-budget Wanda with separate-budget QK-Wanda holds per-projection deletion counts fixed. Across the three largest checkpoints and nine sparsities, the QK score lowers QK error in all 27 configurations, WikiText-2 PPL in 22, and C4 PPL in 20. At 80% on Llama-2-70B, it reduces WikiText-2/C4 PPL from 4.13/6.53 to 3.83/6.14 and QK error from 7.19% to 1.58%; a shared budget further reduces PPL to 3.63/5.97. These results show that scoring and budget allocation both contribute. Full curves and family tables in Appendices I and G .
blocks.zh: 放松万达的排位配额, 在80%时,矩阵预算降低了Llama-2-70B和Quen2.5-72B的PPL度量衡,但在Llama-31-70B时则恶化(表2)。 将矩阵预算Wanda与单独预算QK-Wanda进行比较后,每个预测的删除数保持不变。 通过三个最大的检查站和9个垃圾堆,QK的得分降低了所有27个配置中的QK错误,Wikitext-2 PPL为22个,C4 PPL为20个. 在Llama-2-70B上为80%,将Wikitext-2/C4 PPL从4.13/6.53降至3.83/6.14,QK错误从7.19%降至1.58%;共享预算进一步将PPL降至3.63/5.97. 这些结果表明,评分和预算分配都作出了贡献。 附录一和G中的全曲线和家庭表。

blocks.en: Figure 2 gives the Llama-2-70B sweep. At 50%, absolute PPL gains are small (WikiText-2/C4 3.36/5.74 to 3.33/5.72). At 90%, PPL decreases from 11.71/13.92 to 4.74/7.00 and QK error from 17.12% to 2.87%; The four main curves isolate row-wise Wanda, matrix-budget Wanda, and the two QK budgets for QK-Wanda; additional scoring variants are shown in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 图2给出了Llama-2-70B扫描. 50%时,PPL的绝对收益很小(Wikitext-2/C4 3.36/5.74至3.333/5.72). 90%时,PPL从11.71/13.92降至4.74/7.00,QK差错从17.12%降至2.87%; 四条主曲线隔离了行向的Wanda,矩阵预算的Wanda,以及QK-Wanda的两个QK预算;附加的积分变量在附录中列出.

blocks.en: 4.3 Results across all model sizes
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 所有模型大小的成果

blocks.en: Across 135 checkpoint–sparsity configurations, shared-budget QK-Wanda produces lower WikiText-2 PPL in 103, lower C4 PPL in 101, and lower full QK error in 133. Mean zero-shot accuracy increases in 30 of 45 evaluated configurations. These descriptive sign counts include arbitrarily small differences; Appendix G.5 gives detailed accounting.
blocks.zh: 跨越135个检查站 - 比例配置,共享预算 QK-万达在103中生产下Wikitext-2 PPL,在101中生产下C4 PPL,在133中生产下全QK错误. 平均零射精度在45个评价配置中增加了30个。 这些描述性标志计数包括任意的微小差异;附录G.5提供了详细的核算.

blocks.en: The two exceptions to lower full QK error are Llama-3.2-3B at 80% and 90% sparsity: QK-Wanda gives 10.31% and 24.87%, compared with Wanda's 9.87% and 21.27%. Exact single-deletion costs and an additive mask-selection surrogate do not guarantee a smaller coupled error after many deletions. The mean of per-checkpoint relative QK-error reductions is 60.35% at 50% sparsity and 44.70% at 80%; the corresponding medians are 60.70% and 50.09%, and the minimum at 80% is − 4.42 % -4.42\% . The diagnostic measures pre-RoPE products on common dense block inputs; it does not measure how RoPE and softmax transform perturbations or how pruning errors accumulate across blocks.
blocks.zh: 下方完全QK误差的两个例外是Llama-3.2-3B,为80%和90%:QK-Wanda给出了10.31%和24.87%,而Wanda给出的是9.87%和21.27%. 精确的单删除成本和添加剂的遮罩选择代用,并不能保证在多次删除后出现较小的偶联错误. 每个检查点相对QK-error减少的平均值为60.35%,为50%,44.70%,为80%;相应的中位数为60.70%和50.09%,最低为80%-4.42%-4.42-%。 诊断对常见密集块输入的RoPE产品进行前计量;它没有测量RoPE和软max如何转变扰动,或者如何在块间堆积推移错误.

blocks.en: At 80%, mean-accuracy gains are 0.76, 5.28, 7.77, and 5.94 percentage points on TinyLlama and Llama-2-7B/13B/70B. Qwen2.5-72B gains 0.56 points. Llama-3.1-8B illustrates a different tradeoff: WikiText-2/C4 PPL worsens from 8.89/13.54 to 13.47/21.97, yet mean accuracy rises from 59.64% to 60.61%. All four Llama 3 sizes have worse PPL on both datasets at 80%. Neither local reconstruction nor PPL alone predicts every task outcome; Appendix H retains the full task scores.
blocks.zh: 平均准确率达到80%,在TinyLlama和Llama-2-7B/13B/70B上为0.76、5.28、7.77和5.94个百分点。 Quen2.5-72B获得0.56分. Llama-3.1-8B说明了不同的取舍: Wikitext-2/C4 PPL从8.89/13.54恶化到13.47/21.97,但平均精度从59.64%上升至60.61%. 所有4个Llama 3尺寸的PPL在两个数据集上都有更差的PPL,为80%. 无论是本地重建还是PPL本身都无法预测每个任务结果;附录H保留了全部任务分数.

blocks.en: 4.4 Separate and shared QK budgets
blocks.zh: 4.4 单独分担的QK预算

blocks.en: Figure 3: QK-Wanda redistributes a shared 50% pruning budget between query and key weights across transformer blocks. blocks.en: Across the 135 checkpoint–sparsity configurations, shared QK budgets lowered WikiText-2 PPL in 112, C4 PPL in 119, and QK error in 122 relative to separate budgets (Appendix G.5 ). Sharing was not uniformly better: Llama-2-7B has slightly lower QK error under separate budgets at 50% and 80%, and at 90% separate budgets give lower WikiText-2/C4 PPL (29.04/40.18 versus 30.13/41.87).

The horizontal axis follows transformer blocks from the input side to the final block; solid and dashed curves show the percentages removed from W Q W^{Q} and W K W^{K} , respectively. Their allocation is nearly balanced, but consistently favors retaining W Q W^{Q} weights after the first few blocks: mean removal rates for W Q W^{Q} and W K W^{K} are 48.09%/51.91% and 47.98%/52.02%, respectively.

blocks.en: Llama-2-70B and Qwen2.5-72B in the right panel show the opposite preference: both preserve a larger fraction of the weights in W K W^{K} throughout their 80 blocks. W Q W^{Q} removal stays slightly above 50%, while W K W^{K} removal is substantially lower. For example, Llama-2-70B removes 52.76% of W Q W^{Q} weights and 27.91% of W K W^{K} weights on average. This preference persists across depth, although W K W^{K} removal fluctuates more between blocks.

blocks.en: In MHA, W Q W^{Q} and W K W^{K} have equal parameter counts, and the observed removal fractions generally stay close to 50%. In GQA, several query heads share each key head, making W Q W^{Q} larger than W K W^{K} . A small increase in the fraction removed from W Q W^{Q} therefore allows a much larger decrease in the fraction removed from W K W^{K} , while exactly half of the combined weights are removed.
blocks.zh: 在MHA中,W Q W^{Q}和W K W^{K}有等参数计数,观测到的去除分数一般保持接近50%. 在GQA中,多个查询头共享每个密钥头,使得W Q WQQQQ 大于W K WQK}. 因此,从W Q W Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q Q )中去除的分数略有增加,同时将合并重量的完全一半去除.

blocks.en: The QK scores thus provide an inexpensive way to decide how much of the pruning budget each projection should receive. The resulting sparsities vary from block to block, reflecting differences in the reconstruction costs of removing W Q W^{Q} and W K W^{K} weights. This allocation emerges directly from the scores, without specifying a fixed sparsity for each projection or hand-tuning a schedule across blocks. Beyond pruning, these results motivate exploring similar reconstruction-based budget allocation for other compression methods, such as mixed-precision quantization.
blocks.zh: 因此,QK分数提供了一种费用低廉的方法,可以决定每项预测应获得多少支出预算。 由此产生的痉挛因块而异,反映了去除W Q W^{Q}和W K W^{K}重量的重建成本差异. 这种分配直接来自分数,没有为每次投影指定固定的抽筋,也没有按区块手调时间表。 除了挤压外,这些结果还激励人们探索类似的基于重建的预算拨款,用于其他压缩方法,如混合精度量化。

blocks.en: 4.5 Pruning all block linear projections
blocks.zh: 4.5 所有块线性预测

blocks.en: Table 3: Pruning all seven transformer-block projections at 30% and 50% sparsity. Wanda + QK-Wanda combines shared-budget QK pruning with row-wise Wanda on the remaining projections. Accuracy is the seven-task zero-shot mean (%). Bold marks better unrounded values within each checkpoint and sparsity.

blocks.en: We use QK-Wanda with a shared QK budget while retaining row-wise Wanda on the value, output, and MLP projections. Table 3 compares this hybrid with row-wise Wanda throughout at 30% and 50% full-block sparsity. All seven block projections are pruned; embeddings, biases, normalization parameters and the output head remain dense. We evaluate the same pruned model on all seven zero-shot tasks, without additional pruning or training.
blocks.zh: 我们使用QK-万达与共享的QK预算,同时在数值,输出,和MLP预测上保持逐行Wanda. 表3以30%和50%的整块筋膜将这种混合物与Wanda进行对比。 所有7个区块的预测都经过压缩;嵌入、偏差、正常化参数和输出头仍然密集。 我们对所有7个零镜头任务 都进行了同样的评价, 而没有进行额外的探测或训练。

blocks.en: The hybrid lowers PPL in 12 of 12 checkpoint–sparsity–dataset comparisons. At 50% on TinyLlama, WikiText-2/C4 PPL changes from 11.52/13.85 to 11.22/13.62. At 50% on Llama-2-7B, WikiText-2/C4 PPL changes from 6.89/9.06 to 6.84/9.05. At 50% on Llama-2-13B, WikiText-2/C4 PPL changes from 5.90/8.00 to 5.86/7.98. Mean accuracy is higher in 4 of 6 completed comparisons. These results show that QK-Wanda can be combined with pruning the remaining block projections, extending its use beyond query and key pruning alone.
blocks.zh: 混合体在12个检查站-sparsity-dataset比较中的12个降低了PPL. 在 TinyLlama 上的50%时, Wikitext-2/C4 PPL 从11.52/13.85改为11.22/13.62. 在Llama-2-7B上为50%,Wikitext-2/C4 PPL 从6.89/9.06改为6.84/9.05. 在Llama-2-13B上的50%,Wikitext-2/C4 PPL 从5.90/8.00改为5.86/7.98。 在6项已完成的比较中,4项比较的平均准确度较高。 这些结果显示,QK-万达可以结合对剩余的块预测进行普鲁士,将其使用范围扩大到了查询之外,而仅是密钥普鲁士.

blocks.en: 4.6 QK-Wanda variants
blocks.zh: 4.6 QK-万达变种

blocks.en: We tested three extensions to the base unmasked loss in Equation 6 . Rotary position embeddings (RoPE, R) rotate queries and keys before their dot products, so reconstruction can instead target post-RoPE products. Centering (C) removes the mean reconstruction error across eligible keys for each query: adding the same constant to every allowed logit in a query row leaves its softmax unchanged, motivating an objective that ignores such shifts. A causal mask (M) restricts reconstruction to keys at or before the query position, matching the pairs accessible to decoder attention. These choices modify the pruning objective, not the model’s attention computation.
blocks.zh: 我们在方程式6测试了三台无假冒损失的基地 旋转位置嵌入(ROPE,R)在其点产品之前旋转查询和密钥,因此重建可以转而瞄准ROPE后产品. Centering (C) 清除每个查询中合格密钥之间的平均重建错误: 在查询行中每个允许的登录中添加相同的常数会使其软度不变,激发一个忽略这种变化的目标. 一个因果掩码(M)将重建限制在查询位置或之前的密钥,匹配可访问的对子以解码注意力. 这些选择修改了运行目标,而不是模型的注意力计算.

blocks.en: Appendix P compares all eight combinations on six checkpoints at 50% and 80% shared QK sparsity, with PPL and seven-task accuracy. We found no consistent downstream advantage from the added switches: their effects depend on checkpoint, sparsity, and metric, and some combinations worsen results. Post-RoPE centering with a causal mask (MRC) narrows the PPL gap on Llama-3.1-70B relative to base QK-Wanda, but still trails Wanda and lowers mean accuracy ( Section 4.2 ). We therefore retain the simple unmasked objective as the base method and report the extended objectives, derivations, and comparisons in the appendices.
blocks.zh: 附 录 P比较了6个检查站的所有8个组合,50%和80%共享QK垃圾,与PPL和7个任务精准. 我们发现增加的开关在下游没有一致的好处:其影响取决于检查站、垃圾堆和衡量标准,有些组合使结果恶化。 使用因果面具(MRC)的ROPE后中心相对基座QK-Wanda缩小了Llama-3.1-70B上的PPL缺口,但仍追随Wanda,并降低平均精度(第4.2节). 因此,我们保留了简单的未装模作样的目标作为基本方法,并在附录中报告扩大的目标、推论和比较。

blocks.en: QK-Wanda’s scores for W Q W^{Q} depend on key activations, and its scores for W K W^{K} depend on query activations. Removing weights from one projection can therefore change the scores of the remaining weights in the other. Wanda’s scores, in contrast, stay unchanged when the projection inputs are fixed. This dependence suggests pruning in small steps and refreshing the scores as weights are removed. We tested this approach by pruning part of W Q W^{Q} and W K W^{K} simultaneously, recomputing both sets of scores from the partially pruned projections, and repeating until reaching the target sparsity. The tested schedules did not improve PPL: changes were negligible under row budgets, while progressive pruning worsened PPL under separate matrix budgets. Appendix K gives the schedules and results. This study and the three-seed ablation used distinct calibration protocols and are excluded from the main aggregate.
blocks.zh: QK-万达的WQ WQQQ的得分取决于关键激活,其WK WQK的得分则取决于查询激活. 因此,从一个投影中去除权重可以改变另一个投影中剩余权重的分数. 而万达的得分则在预测投入固定后保持不变. 这种依赖性暗示在小步中奔跑,并在去除权重后刷新分数. 我们测试了这个方法,同时对W Q W Q 和 W K W QK 的部分进行推波助澜,从部分推波助澜的预测中重新计算两套分数,并重复到达到目标抽筋. 测试的时间表没有改善PPL:在行预算中变化微不足道,而在单独的矩阵预算下,逐步的挤压则使PPL恶化。 附录K列出时间表和结果。 这项研究和三籽b使用了不同的校准规程,被排除在主集合之外.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Scope
blocks.zh: 5 限制和范围

blocks.en: Lower full QK error does not guarantee lower PPL or higher task accuracy. At 80% QK sparsity, all four Llama 3 checkpoints have higher PPL than Wanda, and three have lower QK error. Llama-3.1-70B’s mean accuracy gap is only 0.71 percentage points despite much higher PPL; this does not establish statistical equivalence or preserved generative quality. Individual task results and PPL remain complementary.
blocks.zh: 更低的全QK错误并不能保证更低的PPL或更高的任务准确性. 在80%的QK垃圾堆中,所有四个Llama 3检查站的PPL都比Wanda高,三个的QK错误更低. 拉玛-3.1-70 B的平均精度差距只有0.71个百分点,尽管PPL要高得多;这并不能确定统计等值或保存的基因质量. 个别任务结果和PPL仍然是相辅相成的。

blocks.en: The scores are exact for a single weight deletion, but do not guarantee an optimal mask when many weights are removed. Minimizing QK reconstruction error also does not guarantee minimizing reconstruction error at the output of the attention layer or transformer block. The held-out QK diagnostic measures the same type of local objective used for scoring; it is not independent evidence of downstream quality. Models with additional nonlinear QK transformations require separate treatment.
blocks.zh: 单重删除的分数是准确的,但当许多重量被移除时,并不能保证一个最佳的面具. 最小化QK重建错误也不能保证最小化注意层或变压器块输出的重建错误. 被搁置的QK诊断测量方法与评分所用的当地目标类型相同;它不是下游质量的独立证据. 附加非线性QK变换的模型需要单独处理.

blocks.en: Our main results concern QK-only unstructured pruning. Setting weights to zero does not by itself reduce dense-kernel runtime or storage; we do not benchmark inference speedups or hardware-supported N:M sparsity. Full-block evidence covers only TinyLlama-1.1B and Llama-2-7B/13B at 30% and 50%.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要结果只涉及QK无结构的挤压. 将权重设定为零本身并不会减少密集内核运行时间或存储;我们不以基准推论速度或硬件支持的N:M Sparersity为基准. 全块证据仅涵盖TinyLlama-1.1B和Llama-2-7B/13B,分别为30%和50%.

blocks.en: Compensating updates to surviving weights remain outside this study.
blocks.zh: 对存活体重的更新进行补偿,仍留在本研究之外。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: QK-Wanda couples query and key pruning through exact individual weight-deletion costs for QK reconstruction, without gradients or updates to retained weights. With the main calibration protocol, measured pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200, averaged across the four benchmarked model sizes. Across 15 checkpoints, its shared budget lowers QK reconstruction error in 133 of 135 configurations and often improves perplexity and mean zero-shot accuracy. Llama 3 highlights the limits of this local objective: lower QK error can accompany much higher perplexity, even when mean zero-shot accuracy changes relatively little. These results show the promise of coupled scoring as a practical, inexpensive pruning criterion, while emphasizing that reconstruction quality alone does not determine downstream performance. Accounting for propagated errors and combining the scores with compensating weight updates are directions for future work.
blocks.zh: QK-旺达夫妇查询和按键通过QK重建的精确的个人减重成本,没有梯度或更新保留重量. 采用主校准规程,测得的螺旋桨比A100上的万达长1.3%,H200上的长3.1%,平均跨四个基准模型大小. 通过15个检查站,其共同预算降低了135个配置中的133个的QK重建错误,并往往提高了模糊性,意味着零射精度。 Llama 3凸显了这个局部目标的极限:较低的QK差错可以伴随更复杂的程度,即使平均值零射精度变化相对较小. 这些结果表明,有希望将附加评分作为一项实际、廉价的打分标准,同时强调重建质量本身并不决定下游的业绩。 说明所传播的错误,将分数与补偿重量更新相结合,是未来工作的方向。

blocks.en: B.1 Causal masking: QK-Wanda-M
blocks.zh: B.1 因果关系面具:QK-Wanda-M

blocks.en: Section 3.2 treats shared key heads with an unmasked reconstruction objective. Here we additionally restrict reconstruction to causally allowed pairs, while retaining the same head notation. The following explanation and scores define QK-Wanda-M . A causal mask prevents each query from attending to future tokens ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . The reconstruction objective should therefore retain only token pairs with key position u ≤ t u\leq t for query position t t . Grouped-query attention (GQA) lets several query heads share one key/value head, reducing KV-cache memory and bandwidth during decoding ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) . For example, Llama 3.1-8B uses 32 query heads and 8 key/value heads, so each group of four query heads shares one key head and one value head ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . We account for both causal masking and shared keys in the reconstruction loss and its single-deletion scores below. This causal, pre-RoPE formulation defines the masked variant, QK-Wanda-M .
blocks.zh: 第3.2节处理共同的关键头像,其重建目标未露面。 在这里,我们还把重建限制在因果允许的配对上,同时保留同样的头标注. 以下解释和分数定义了QK-万达-M. 一个因果面具使每个查询都无法关注未来的令牌(Vaswani等人,2017年). 因此,重建目标应只保留带有 u ≤ t u\leq t 键位的符号对,用于查询位置 t 。 grouped-query attention(GQA)让多个查询头共享一个密钥/值头,在解码过程中减少KV-cache内存和带宽(Ainslie等人,2023年). 例如,Llama 3.1-8B使用32个查询头和8个键/值头,因此每组4个查询头共用一个键头和一个值头(Grattafiori等人,2024年). 我们在重建损失及其以下单项删除分数中,既记述了因果掩盖,也记述了共享的关键。 这种因果,RoPE前配体定义了蒙面变体QK-Wanda-M.

Deleting a query weight changes one query head; deleting a key weight changes every product involving that key head. The row slices K ( g ) i , 1 : t K^{(g)}_{i,1:t} and Q ( h ) i , u : T Q^{(h)}_{i,u:T} select coordinate i i over the key prefix and query suffix. We use S ^ \hat{S} for causal scores and S S for unmasked scores. In MHA, each key head serves exactly one query head, so ℋ g = { g } \mathcal{H}_{g}=\{g\} and the head sum reduces to a single contribution. blocks.en: B.4 When do row-wise masks coincide with Wanda?
blocks.zh: B.4 联合国 什么时候和万达碰面?

blocks.en: For one unmasked sequence, Equation 5 multiplies every Wanda score in query row i i by the same factor ‖ K i : ‖ 2 2 \left\lVert K_{i:}\right\rVert_{2}^{2} , and every score in key row i i by ‖ Q i : ‖ 2 2 \left\lVert Q_{i:}\right\rVert_{2}^{2} . A positive factor preserves rankings and ties, so identical per-row deletion counts and tie handling give identical masks. If the factor is zero, all QK scores in that row tie and equivalence is not guaranteed. The same argument holds for the grouped opposite-head energy in the single-sequence GQA formula ( Section C.1 ). For multiple independent sequences, the exact score averages products of input and opposite-side energies; these generally cannot be factored into a Wanda score times a row constant.

Vert QQi: @ @右\rVert\2\2}. 一个正因子保留了排名和领带,所以相同的每行删除计数和领带处理会得到相同的口罩. 如果因数为0,则该行平局中的所有QK分数和等值都得不到保证. 同样的论点也适用于单序列GQA公式(C.1节)中分组的对头能量。 对于多个独立的序列,精确的得分平均值是输入和对面能量的产物;这些一般不能计入万达的得分乘以一行常数.

blocks.en:
Causal masking can break the equivalence even for one sequence and one head. Set X = ( 1 0 0 1 ) , W Q = ( 2 1 ) , W K = ( 1 3 ) , X=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\
0&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad W^{Q}=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad W^{K}=\begin{pmatrix}1&3\end{pmatrix}, with zero biases. Then Q = ( 2 , 1 ) Q=(2,1) and K = ( 1 , 3 ) K=(1,3) . For the two query weights, Wanda gives scores ( 4 , 1 ) (4,1) , and the unmasked score gives ( 40 , 10 ) (40,10) : both delete the second weight at 50% row sparsity. The causal scores are instead ( 4 , 10 ) (4,10) , because the first query sees only the first key whereas the second sees both. They delete the first weight. Thus a row-wise causal control is informative; the unmasked equivalence is not a reason to omit it.

blocks.en: The implementation accumulates in FP32 and retains the common attention-scale factor 1 / m 1/m in both score arrays. The formulas report unscaled deletion costs; this common factor preserves their ranking under separate or shared budgets. Within a block, both masks are formed before either is applied, then the sparse block output is propagated. Thus the inputs are fixed during a local scoring decision, even though later blocks receive method-specific sparse inputs.
blocks.zh: 执行积累在FP32中,在两个分数阵列中都保留了共同的注意尺度系数1/m1/m. 公式报告未分级的删除费用;这一共同因素保留了在单独或共享预算下的排名。 在一个区块内,两个口罩都是在两个区块被应用之前形成的,然后传播稀少的区块输出. 因此,投入在当地评分决定期间是固定的,即使以后的区块得到的方法特有的稀疏投入。

blocks.en: B.8 Does causal masking improve perplexity?
blocks.zh: B.8 联合国 因果关系掩盖会增加困惑吗?

blocks.en: The causal objective excludes products between a query and future keys, which cannot contribute to decoder attention. This structural match does not by itself establish a downstream advantage over the unmasked objective. We therefore compared the two pre-RoPE scores on six checkpoints spanning Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, including both MHA and GQA. We held the checkpoint revision, calibration samples, numerical precision, pruning procedure, and shared QK budget fixed, and measured WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity at 30%, 50%, and 80% sparsity. Table B.1 reports the comparison.
blocks.zh: 因果目标将查询与未来密钥之间的产品排除在外,这无助于解码注意力. 这种结构匹配本身并不能确立下游优于无假面目标. 因此,我们比较了在跨越Llama 2、Llama 3和Quen2.5的6个检查站(包括MHA和GQA)的两个RoPE前分数。 我们把检查点修改、校准样本、数字精度、推算程序以及共享QK预算固定下来, 并用30%、50%和80%的棱率测量了WikiText-2和C4的模糊度。 表B.1报告了比较情况。

blocks.en: Table B.1: Causal QK-Wanda-M versus unmasked QK-Wanda with shared QK budgets. Both variants use the same checkpoint and calibration protocol. Lower perplexity is better; bold marks the better value in each pair, including ties at the displayed precision.
blocks.zh: 表B.1:因果分类 M与未装模作样的QK-Wanda,共享QK预算. 两个变体都使用相同的检查站和校准协议. 更低的模糊度更好;粗体标记每对中更好的值,包括显示精度的链接.

blocks.en: Neither variant uniformly dominated. At 30% and 50% sparsity, all absolute PPL differences were below 0.005. At 80%, unmasked scoring improved both datasets for Llama-2-7B/13B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5-72B; the other two checkpoints had mixed outcomes. The largest improvement was on Llama-3.1-8B, from 13.814 to 13.470 on WikiText-2 and from 22.361 to 21.967 on C4. Across all 18 model–sparsity pairs, unmasked scoring yielded lower PPL in 11 comparisons on WikiText-2 and 12 on C4, counting unrounded values. These single-calibration-seed measurements do not establish general empirical superiority of the causal variant: its motivation is the restriction to attention-eligible products, while the observed PPL advantage depends on the checkpoint and sparsity. We make no inference about zero-shot accuracy from this PPL-only comparison.
blocks.zh: 两种变体均不受统一支配。 所有绝对的PPL差异均低于0.005。 80%的无假分改进了Llama-2-7B/13B、Llama-3.1-8B和Qun2.5-72B的数据集;另外两个检查站的结果好坏参半。 最大的改进是在Llama-3.1-8B上,从13.814到13.470在Wikitext-2上,从22.361到21.967在C4上. 在所有18个模型中, 平面对齐, 未显示的分数在WikiText-2的11个比较和C4的12个比较中得出了较低的PPL, 计算出未圆形值。 这些单校准种子的测量不能确定因果变体的一般经验优越性:其动机是对受关注的合格产品的限制,而观察到的PPL的优势则取决于检查站和痉挛. 我们不推断零射精度 仅从PPL的比较。

Appendix D Causal and RoPE-Aware Ablation at 8192 Calibration Tokens
blocks.zh: 附录D Causal和RoPE-Aware 校准托肯斯

blocks.en: We compared causal pre-RoPE QK-Wanda-M with causal-plus-RoPE QK-Wanda-MR on Llama-3.2-1B/3B and Llama-3.1-8B at 50% and 80% QK sparsity. Both variants used separate whole-matrix budgets, one-shot masks, and identical calibration inputs for each seed. This protocol used 256 C4 sequences of length 32 and calibration seeds 0, 1, and 2; PPL evaluation used length 2048. The calibration budget and context differ from the main study, so these comparisons are not included in its win/loss counts.
blocks.zh: 我们在Llama-3.2-1B/3B和Llama-31-8B上,将ROPE QK-Wanda-M前因果比对为因果+-ROPE QK-Wanda-MR,比对为50%和80%的QK垃圾。 两个变种都采用了单独的全阵容预算,单发口罩,以及每个种子相同的校准输入. 这个协议使用了长度32的256个C4序列和校准种子0,1和2;PPL评价使用了长度2048. 校准预算和上下文与主要研究不同,因此这些比较不计入其损益计数中.

blocks.en: Table 5: Causal pre-RoPE (M) and causal-plus-RoPE (MR) with separate matrix budgets and 256 × 32 256\times 32 calibration tokens. PPL is the mean and sample standard deviation over three calibration seeds. Post-RoPE QK error is the pooled relative squared error (%), averaged over seeds. Bold marks lower displayed means within each checkpoint and sparsity, including ties.

blocks.en: The causal pre-RoPE variant had lower mean PPL on both datasets in all six model–sparsity pairs. The RoPE-aware variant had lower post-RoPE QK error in four of six pairs; its advantage was consistent at 50% but mixed at 80%. Thus, including RoPE in the reconstruction target did not improve PPL in this ablation. These results do not establish the same ordering for shared budgets or the main calibration protocol.
blocks.zh: 在所有的6个模型-sparsity配对中,ROPE变体在两个数据集上的因果前的PPL均值较低. RoPE-aware变体在6对中的4对中具有较低的后ROPE QK差错;其优势一致为50%,但混合为80%. 因此,将ROPE纳入重建目标,并没有改善PPL在这一减缩中的情况。 这些结果没有为共享预算或主要校准协议确定相同的顺序.

blocks.en: The held-out diagnostics used 16 C4 sequences of length 512, seed 20260810, starting from validation document row 1100. Post-RoPE QK and block-output errors use the pooled squared-error ratio in Equation 51 . Causal pre-RoPE scoring also produced lower mean same-input block-output error in all six pairs and lower rollout block-output error in four of six. As with the main QK-error diagnostic, these stages need not rank masks in the same order as PPL. The unmasked variant is derived in Appendix C.1 ; this ablation compares only the two causal variants.
blocks.zh: 搁置的诊断从鉴定文件第1100行开始,使用了16个长度512,种子20260810的C4序列. 后ROPE QK和块输出错误在方程式51中使用集合方格-误差比. Causal pre-RoPE评分也在所有6对中产生了较低的平均同输入区块输出错误,在6对中产生了较低的推出区块输出错误。 如同主要的QK-error诊断一样,这些阶段不需要按照PPL的顺序排列口罩. 无假变体在附录C.1中推导出;这种衰减只比较了两个因果变体.

blocks.en: For each of the two QK scoring variants, three checkpoints, and two sparsities, we computed the sample standard deviation of PPL over calibration seeds 0, 1, and 2. Across the six model–variant configurations at 50%, the standard deviations ranged from 0.00015 to 0.01964 on WikiText-2 and from 0.00089 to 0.07280 on C4. At 80%, the respective ranges were 0.04917–0.85345 and 0.03766–2.75072. These are within-configuration seed variations, not variation across models. The different calibration and allocation protocol prevents treating these ranges as uncertainty bounds for the main single-seed comparisons.
blocks.zh: 对于两个QK分数变体,三个检查站和两个板块,我们分别计算了PPL相对于校准种子0,1和2的样本标准差. 在五成的六种模型中,标准偏差从Wikitext-2的0.00015到0.01964,到C4的0.00089到0.07280。 按80%计算,相应的幅度为0.04917-0.85345和0.03766-2.75072。 这些是内部的种子变异,而不是模型之间的变异. 不同的校准和分配协议阻止将这些范围作为主要单一种子比较的不确定性界限。

blocks.en: Appendix E Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 附录E 实验细节

blocks.en: This appendix specifies the data, evaluation procedures, and implementation conventions used in the experiments. We distinguish pruning calibration from the reconstruction diagnostic and downstream evaluation so that their results can be interpreted under the appropriate input and aggregation rules.
blocks.zh: 本附录具体说明了试验中使用的数据、评估程序和执行公约。 我们把校准与重建诊断和下游评价区分开来,以便根据适当的投入和汇总规则解释其结果。

blocks.en: E.1 Calibration and perplexity data
blocks.zh: E.1 校准和复杂度数据

blocks.en: We sample calibration text from the English C4 training shard en/c4-train.00000-of-01024.json.gz , using each checkpoint’s native tokenizer. Each base sample is a contiguous 2048-token window from one document. The main experiments use seed 0 and 256 windows, giving 524,288 tokens. Splitting these windows into length-64 segments gives 8192 independent calibration sequences. Positions restart in each segment; there is no padding, packing, or attention across segments. Every method and sparsity uses the same sampled token manifest within a checkpoint. Token IDs are not shared between models with different tokenizers.
blocks.zh: 我们用每个检查点的本地标注器, 每个基样都是从一个文档中相邻的2048个托肯窗口. 主要实验使用0号种子和256个窗户,给出524,288个令牌. 将这些窗口分割成长-64段会给出8192个独立的校准序列. 每个段恢复位置;没有铺垫、包装或各段的注意。 每一种方法和垃圾都使用在检查站内显示的相同的抽样标记。 键 ID不与不同标致器的模型共享.

blocks.en: Appendix F varies sample count through nested subsets of the base windows and context length through different segmentations of the same 524,288-token pool. Every tested length T T divides 2048, so all segmentations retain exactly the same tokens and use 524,288 / T 524{,}288/T independent sequences. Calibration batches contain 2048 / T 2048/T segments, keeping 2048 tokens per forward pass; PPL evaluation stays at length 2048. Causal sums are computed within each sequence before batch aggregation, while QK-Wanda uses all pairs within each segment. The original Llama-3.1-8B T = 2048 T=2048 comparison reuses the identical N = 256 N=256 sample-count configuration. Appendix D uses a separate three-seed calibration protocol.
blocks.zh: 附 录 F通过基窗的嵌套子集和上下文长度通过同一524,288个托肯池的不同区块来进行样本计数而变化. 每个测试的长度T T除以2048,因此所有分块都保留了完全相同的符号,并使用524,288 / T 524{,}288/T独立序列. 校准批次包含2048 / T 2048/T段,每前行通行证保留2048个令牌;PPL评价保持2048长度. 在分批汇总之前,因果总和按各个顺序计算,而QK-Wanda则使用每个段内的所有对数。 最初的Llama-31-8B T = 2048 T =2048 比较再利用相同的N = 256 N = 256 样本计数配置. 附 录 D使用单独的三种子校准协议.

blocks.en: WikiText-2 evaluation used the wikitext-2-raw-v1 test split, joining text entries with two newline characters before tokenization. C4 evaluation used the first 1100 documents of en/c4-validation.00000-of-00008.json.gz , joined by spaces and truncated to at most 256 × 2048 256\times 2048 tokens. We evaluated complete, non-overlapping 2048-token windows and discarded the final incomplete window. These same evaluation sets informed the calibration-sensitivity comparisons on Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-2-7B; no document range was reserved exclusively for development. The resulting token sequences were identical across pruning configurations for each checkpoint and tokenizer. We used batch size one, disabled the KV cache, and computed full-vocabulary next-token cross-entropy. To reduce memory use, we evaluated the vocabulary projection in 128-token chunks, preserving FP32 logits and the same cross-entropy calculation.
blocks.zh: WikiText-2评价使用wikitext-2-raw-v1测试拆分,在表示符号化前用两个新线字符加入文本条目. C4评价使用en/c4-validation.00000-of-0008.json.gz的前1100份文件,加上空格,并缩短到最多256×2048 256\times 2048令牌. 我们评估了2048个没有重叠的完整窗口,并丢弃了最后的不完整窗口。 这些评价集为Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-2-7B的校准敏感性比较提供了参考;没有文件范围专门用于开发。 由此得出的每个检查站和象征性装置的套路配置序列相同。 我们使用批量尺寸1, 禁用 KV 缓存, 并计算全省 下一个托盘交叉。 为了减少内存使用,我们用128个托肯块评价了词汇投影,保留了FP32对数和相同的交叉切入计算.

blocks.en: E.2 Zero-shot evaluation
blocks.zh: E.2 零镜头评价

blocks.en: We evaluated the dense base checkpoints of TinyLlama-1.1B, Llama 2 7B/13B/70B, Llama-3.2-1B/3B, Llama-3.1-8B/70B, and Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B/14B/32B/72B, together with QK-only pruning at 30%, 50%, and 80% sparsity. The comparisons include row-wise Wanda , QK-Wanda with separate and shared budgets, and the labeled scoring variants in the result tables. For TinyLlama and Llama 2 7B/13B, we also evaluated full-block pruning with Wanda and the QK-Wanda-M hybrid at 30%, 50%, and 80% ( Table 9 ). The six QK-Wanda hybrid configurations at 30% and 50% appear in Table 3 . We applied the exact saved masks from the corresponding PPL experiments to the same pinned checkpoints, without repeating pruning or updating retained weights. In the QK-only setting, all non-QK parameters remained unchanged. Full-block masks additionally pruned value, output, and MLP projections; embeddings, normalization parameters, biases, and the language-model head remained unchanged. We reused each checkpoint’s dense reference across pruning scopes. Appendix N additionally evaluates nine matrix-budget Wanda configurations on the three largest checkpoints under this same task protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了TinyLlama-1.1B、Llama 2 7B/13B/70B、Llama-32-1B/3B、Llama-3.1-8B/70B和Quen2.5 0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B/14B/32B/72B的密集基地检查站,以及QK只以30%、50%和80%的垃圾冲压。 比较内容包括按顺序排列的万达,QK-万达,预算分开和共享,结果表中标注的评分变量. 对TinyLlama和Llama 2 7B/13B来说,我们还以30%、50%和80%评价了与万达和QK-万达-M混合体的全块挤压(表9)。 6个QK-万达混合构型以30%和50%的比例出现在表3中. 我们把从相应的PPL实验中节省下来的确切口罩应用到同一个被钉住的检查站,而没有重复检查或更新保留重量。 在仅QK设置中,所有非QK参数保持不变. 全块面遮盖了更多的价值、产出和MLP预测;嵌入、正常化参数、偏差和语言模型头没有变化。 我们重复了每个检查站的密集参考, 附 录 此外,N对本任务议定书下三个最大检查站的九个矩阵预算万达配置进行了评价。

blocks.en: We used LM Evaluation Harness v0.4.12 ( EleutherAI, 2026 ) , with no demonstrations or task subsampling, maximum context length 2048, batch size 4, and evaluation seed 1234. We used scaled dot-product attention throughout. The original 0.5B–32B comparisons used FP16 weights on A100 GPUs: Qwen2.5-32B used two GPUs and the smaller models used one. The additional QK-Wanda and scoring-variant evaluations ran on H200 GPUs with the same task protocol. The Llama 70B checkpoints used FP16 weights on H200 GPUs, and Qwen2.5-72B used BF16 weights on two H200 GPUs under its validated numerical protocol. We evaluated the base models directly, without chat templates or an additional beginning-of-sequence token. The suite comprised BoolQ ( Clark et al., 2019 ) , RTE ( Wang et al., 2018 ) , HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) , WinoGrande ( Sakaguchi et al., 2020 ) , ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , and OpenBookQA ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) . We used the validation splits for BoolQ, RTE, HellaSwag, and WinoGrande (3270, 277, 10042, and 1267 examples), and the test splits for ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, and OpenBookQA (2376, 1172, and 500 examples). Every configuration used identical evaluation examples and prompts. We used accuracy for BoolQ, RTE, and WinoGrande and length-normalized accuracy for HellaSwag, both ARC tasks, and OpenBookQA. The reported zero-shot score was their unweighted arithmetic mean, expressed as a percentage, computed before rounding individual task scores.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了LM评价Harness v0.4.12(EleutherAI,2026),没有演示或任务分样,最大上下文长度2048,批量尺寸4,评价种子1234. 整个过程中,我们一直关注点产品。 最初的0.5B–32B比较在A100GPU上使用了FP16重量: Quen2.5-32B 使用两个GPU,较小的模型使用一个. 额外的QK-Wanda和积分变量评价在H200GPU上运行,任务协议相同. Llama 70B检查站在H200GPU上使用FP16重量,Quen2.5-72B在其经验证的数字协议下在两个H200GPU上使用BF16重量. 我们直接评价了基础模型,没有聊天模板或附加的开始序列符. 套房包括BoulQ(Clark等人,2019年),RTE(Wang等人,2018年),HelaSwag(Zellers等人,2019年),WinoGrande (Sakaguchi等人,2020年),ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge(克拉克等人,2018年),以及OpenBookQA. (米哈伊洛夫等人,2018年). 我们使用BoulQ、RTE、HelaSwag和WinoGrande(3270、277、10042和1267例)的验证分法,以及ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge和OpenBookQA(2376、1172和500例)的验证分法。 每个配置都使用了相同的评价实例和提示. 我们对BoulQ,RTE,和WinoGrande以及长度常态化的精度都用于HellaSwag,两者都是ARC任务,OpenBookQA. 所报告的零射分数是其未加权的算术平均值,以百分比表示,在逐项任务分数四舍五入前计算。

blocks.zh: E.3 重建指标

blocks.en: We sampled 16 held-out C4 validation sequences of length 512 with seed 20260810, restricting sampling to document rows at or after 1100. These documents were disjoint from the C4 perplexity subset and the calibration training split. Each checkpoint used its native tokenizer, with identical held-out tokens across methods and sparsities. We evaluated the saved masks from the PPL experiments, using calibration seed 0. A dense forward pass supplied the same reference inputs to the dense and pruned QK projections in every block.

blocks.en: This diagnostic evaluates complete masks, including interactions among deletions, rather than summing individual deletion scores. It isolates each block’s QK reconstruction on dense inputs; it does not include error propagated from previously pruned blocks. We retained FP16 projection outputs (BF16 for Qwen2.5-72B), computed QK dot products in FP32 with TF32 disabled, and accumulated squared-error sums in FP64. RoPE remained enabled in the dense forward pass that supplied block inputs; the measured products were taken before RoPE.
blocks.zh: 这种诊断评价了完整的口罩,包括删除之间的相互作用,而不是总结个人删除分数. 它将每个块的QK重建隔离在密集的输入上;它不包括从先前被挤压的块传播的错误. 我们保留了FP16的预测产出(Quen2.5-72B的BF16),在FP32中计算QK点产品,而TF32已停用,在FP64中累积了平方差数。 在提供块状投入的密集前方通道中,RoPE仍然被启用;所测量的产品是在RoPE之前取得的。

blocks.en: E.5 Implementation and reproducibility
blocks.zh: E.5 实施和可复制

blocks.en: The original A100 experiments used Python 3.10.14, PyTorch 2.4.1 with CUDA 12.1, Transformers 4.45.2, Accelerate 0.34.2, datasets 2.21.0, and LM Evaluation Harness 0.4.12. Subsequent H200 jobs used Python 3.12.3. Smaller original checkpoints ran on one A100, Qwen2.5-32B on two, and retained Llama 70B configurations on four. The additional QK-Wanda and scoring-variant runs used H200 GPUs. All common QK reconstruction measurements used H200, with two GPUs for 32B/70B/72B. Each measurement retains its hardware and frozen-source provenance.
blocks.zh: 最初的A100实验使用了Python 3.10.14,PyTorch 2.4.1与CUDA 12.1,变形器 4.45.2,加速0.34.2,数据集2.21.0,LM评价哈林斯0.4.12. 后来的H200工作使用了Python 3.123. 较小的原始检查站在1架A100、2架Quen2.5-32B上运行,并在4架上保留了Llama 70B配置。 附加的QK-万达和积分变量运行使用了H200GPU. 所有常见的QK重建测量都使用了H200,两个GPU用于32B/70B/72B. 每一次测量都保留其硬件和冷冻源来源.

blocks.en: Model weights are FP16 except on Qwen2.5-72B, which uses BF16 for every method and its dense reference to avoid nonfinite FP16 activations. Pruning statistics are accumulated in FP32. Table 7 lists the pinned model and tokenizer revisions.
blocks.zh: 模型权重是FP16,但Quen2.5-72B上除外,它使用BF16来进行每一种方法及其密集的参考,以避免非无限FP16激活. Pruning统计在FP32中积累. 表7列出了固定模型和标注剂的修订。

blocks.zh: 表7:用于模型和标注器的套装面部存储器标识符和绑定修改。

blocks.en: Our row-wise Wanda implementation removed ⌈ ρ ​ d ⌉ \lceil\rho d\rceil weights per output row of width d d ; the matched row-wise QK-Wanda-M control used the same convention. Separate matrix budgets removed ⌈ ρ ​ n Q ⌉ \lceil\rho n_{Q}\rceil and ⌈ ρ ​ n K ⌉ \lceil\rho n_{K}\rceil weights, and shared budgets removed ⌈ ρ ⁡ ( n Q + n K ) ⌉ \lceil\rho(n_{Q}+n_{K})\rceil . This upward rounding is our implementation convention, not a property attributed to the original Wanda algorithm. The retained Llama-3.1-8B QK sweep used floor at the matrix/pair scope; its shared counts coincide with ceiling at the tested sparsities, while separate counts differ by at most one per projection. The 50% calibration studies also used floor, which equals ceiling for their even row widths and matrix sizes. The 70B/72B matrix-Wanda controls matched separate QK-Wanda-M counts exactly.
blocks.zh: 我们的按行 Wanda 执行删除了 \\ d\ lceil\rho d\rceil 每输出行宽 d d 的重量; 匹配的按行 QK- Wanda- M 控制使用相同的常规 。 单独的矩阵预算移除了 ^\ n Q \ lceil\rho n_{Q}\rceil 和 ^ n K \ lceil\rho n_{k}\rceil 权重, 共享预算移除了 ^ ^ (n Q + n K )\ lceil\rho (n_{Q}+n_{K })\rceil 。 这个向上四舍五入是我们执行公约,不是归属于原万达算法的财产. 保留下来的Llama-3.1-8B QK扫描在矩阵/铺设范围内使用了地板;其共用的计数与测试的抽筋时的上限相吻合,而单独的计数则在每次预测时最多各有一个。 50%的校准研究也使用了地板,这等于其偶数行宽度和矩阵大小的上限. 70B/72B矩阵-万达控制完全符合单独的QK-万达-M计数。

blocks.en: Scores were sorted in ascending order with a stable sort. Ties within a row followed increasing column index; matrix ties followed row-major order; shared ties used all Q entries followed by all K entries, each in row-major order. No independent per-projection or per-head score normalization was applied. Frozen source-manifest hashes, rather than the mutable working tree, identify executed code in the archived study plans ( Table 8 ). Token manifests, exact deletion counts, masks, and metric files were retained.
blocks.zh: 分数按递增顺序排序,稳定排序。 列内绑定随列索引增加;矩阵链接按行主顺序排列;共享链接使用所有Q条目,然后使用所有K条目,每个条目按行主顺序排列。 没有实行独立逐项预测或人均得分正常化。 在存档的学习计划中识别已执行代码(表8),而不是可变的工作树。 保留了托肯清单、准确的删除计数、口罩和度量文件。

blocks.en: The pruning and evaluation implementation, tests, pinned checkpoint configurations, full-precision results, and scripts for reproducing experiments and regenerating tables and figures are available at https://github.com/vectozavr/qk-wanda . The repository README gives environment setup and reproduction commands. Model weights, dataset text, and the large collection of original binary masks are not redistributed; masks can be regenerated, and their recorded hashes and allocation statistics are included. File-integrity manifests document the archived results and their provenance.
blocks.zh: 在https://github.com/vectozavr/qk-wanda上,可以查阅检查和评价的实施、测试、固定检查站配置、完全精确的结果以及复制实验和再生成表格和数字的脚本。 寄存器README给出环境设置和复制命令. 模型权重,数据集文本,以及大量收集的原二进制口罩不重新分配;口罩可以重新生成,并包含其记录的散列和分配统计. 文件集成度显示文件存档结果及其来源。

blocks.en: E.6 Shared QK allocation across transformer blocks
blocks.zh: E.6 各变压器块共享的QK分配

blocks.en: We examined the shared-budget masks at 50% combined QK sparsity for all 15 checkpoints. Each run used QK-Wanda with calibration seed 0 and 8192 C4 training sequences of length 64 tokenized by the checkpoint’s native tokenizer. Each block had its own shared QK budget: the fractions removed from W Q W^{Q} and W K W^{K} could differ, while exactly 50% of their combined weights were removed. The profiles below use the same masks as the PPL and QK-error comparisons. Lines connect every measured block; markers are shown every fourth block, with different starting blocks for each model to reduce overlap.
blocks.zh: 我们检查了所有15个检查站50%的预算口罩。 每一次运行都使用QK-Wanda的校准种子0和8192C4训练序列,长度64,由检查站的本地标致剂标致. 每个区块都有自己的共享QK预算:从W Q W^{Q}和W K W^{K}中去除的分数可能有所不同,而它们合并重量的完全50%被去除. 以下剖面图使用与PPL和QK-error比较相同的口罩. 线路连接每个测量的块;标记显示每第四个块,每个模型都有不同的起始块以减少重叠.

blocks.en: Figure 4: QK-Wanda allocation at a shared 50% budget on Llama 3. Solid lines show query-weight removal and dashed lines key-weight removal; colors and markers identify checkpoints. The dotted line marks 50% removal in each projection.
blocks.zh: 图4 QK-万达在Llama50%的共享预算中的拨款 3个 实线显示取消查询权重和破折线键重;颜色和标记标明检查站。 点行标记为每次投影中去除50%.

blocks.en: All four checkpoints removed a larger fraction of query than key weights in every block. Mean query/key removal rates were 53.66%/35.35% on Llama-3.1-8B, 53.91%/38.28% on Llama-3.2-3B, 54.00%/34.01% on Llama-3.2-1B, 52.70%/28.44% on Llama-3.1-70B. On 70B, key removal ranged from 18.01% to 47.61% across blocks. The allocation varies with depth rather than following a fixed schedule.
blocks.zh: 所有四个检查站都清除了比每个街区关键重量更大的查询。 平均查询/钥匙删除率 53.66%/35.35%在Llama-31-8B上,53.91%/38.28%在Llama-32-3B上,54.0%/34.01%在Llama-32-1B上,52.70%/28.44%在Llama-31-70B上. 在70B上,从18.01%到47.61%的密钥清除跨区块. 分配的深度不同,而不是按照固定的时间表。

With target sparsity ρ \rho , the ceiling convention in Appendix E.5 gives n Q ​ ρ Q + n K ​ ρ K n Q + n K = ⌈ ρ ⁡ ( n Q + n K ) ⌉ n Q + n K . \frac{n_{Q}\rho_{Q}+n_{K}\rho_{K}}{n_{Q}+n_{K}}=\frac{\lceil\rho(n_{Q}+n_{K})\rceil}{n_{Q}+n_{K}}. Consequently, increasing Q sparsity by one percentage point requires decreasing K sparsity by n Q / n K n_{Q}/n_{K} points. This constraint explains the larger amplitude of the K curves; it must be considered when comparing checkpoints.

blocks.en: Figure 5 extends the same analysis to Llama 2 7B/13B/70B and TinyLlama 1.1B. The combined QK removal fraction was exactly 50% in every block, under the same calibration protocol described above.
blocks.zh: 图5将同样的分析延伸至Llama 2 7B/13B/70B和TinyLlama。 1.1B. (英语). 根据上述相同的校准协议,每个区块的QK移除分数完全为50%。

blocks.en: Figure 5: QK-Wanda allocation at a shared 50% budget on TinyLlama and Llama 2. Solid lines show query-weight removal and dashed lines key-weight removal; colors and markers identify checkpoints. The dotted line marks 50% removal in each projection.
blocks.zh: 图5:在TinyLlama和Llama共享50%预算中的QK-Wanda拨款 2. 国家 实线显示取消查询权重和破折线键重;颜色和标记标明检查站。 点行标记为每次投影中去除50%.

blocks.en: Mean query/key removal rates were 48.09%/51.91% on 7B and 47.98%/52.02% on 13B. Both retained a larger fraction of query weights on average. Key sparsity exceeded query sparsity in 30 of 32 blocks on 7B and 39 of 40 blocks on 13B. These models have equally sized query and key projections, so their removal fractions average to 50% within each block.
blocks.zh: 7B的平均查询/钥匙清除率为48.09%/51.91%,13B为47.98%/52.02%。 两者平均保留了较大比例的查询权重。 7B的32个区块中30个和13B的40个区块中的39个都超过了查询系统。 这些模型具有同样大小的查询和关键预测,因此其移除分数在每个区块中平均为50%.

blocks.en: Both checkpoints removed a larger fraction of query than key weights in every block. Mean query/key removal rates were 52.75%/27.96% on TinyLlama and 52.76%/27.91% on Llama 2 70B. On 70B, key removal varied from 21.45% to 39.52% across 80 blocks. Both have an 8:1 query-to-key parameter-count ratio, so a modest increase in query sparsity above 50% permits a much larger decrease in key sparsity.
blocks.zh: 这两个检查站的查询量比每个街区的关键重量要小。 TinyLlama的平均查询/钥匙清除率为52.75%/27.96%,Llama 2 70B的平均查询/钥匙清除率为52.76%/27.91%。 在70B上,从21.45%到39.52%的密钥清除在80个街区之间. 两者都有一个8:1的查询对键参数计数比率,因此略微提高50%以上的查询抽筋率就可以使关键抽筋率大幅降低.

blocks.en: We examined the shared-budget masks from all seven Qwen2.5 checkpoints in Section G.3 , including 72B, at 50% combined QK sparsity. The curves report the fraction removed within each projection at the actual transformer block index. Because Q and K have unequal sizes under GQA, their combined sparsity is weighted by their parameter counts; it remained exactly 50% in every block.
blocks.zh: 我们检查了G.3区所有7个Quen2.5检查站(包括72B)的共享预算口罩,这些口罩加起来是QK的50%。 曲线在实际变压器块指数下报告每个投影中去除的分数. 因为Q和K在GQA下有不均匀的大小,所以其组合的sparsity被其参数计数加权;在每个区块中,它仍然完全50%.

blocks.en: Figure 6: QK-Wanda allocation with a shared 50% budget on Qwen2.5, with 0.5B–3B models in the upper panel and 7B–72B models in the lower panel. Color and marker shape identify the checkpoint within each panel. Solid lines denote W Q W^{Q} , dashed lines denote W K W^{K} , and the dotted line marks separate 50% budgets. Each curve ends at its checkpoint’s final block; 72B extends to block 80.
blocks.zh: 图6:QK-万达分配,在Quen2.5上共享50%的预算,上面面板为0.5B–3B型,下面面板为7B–72B型. 颜色和标记形状在每个面板内标明检查站。 实线表示W Q W Q Q ,虚线表示W K W QK },虚线表示50%的预算。 每条曲线在其检查站的最后街区结束;72B延伸至第80街区.

blocks.en: Mean query/key removal fractions were 53.22%/27.44% on Qwen2.5-0.5B, 53.62%/28.30% on Qwen2.5-1.5B, 53.15%/24.81% on Qwen2.5-3B, 53.02%/28.88% on Qwen2.5-7B, 53.47%/32.65% on Qwen2.5-14B, 53.62%/31.88% on Qwen2.5-32B, 53.18%/24.53% on Qwen2.5-72B. Every block in all seven checkpoints removed a larger fraction of query than key weights. On 72B, key removal ranged from 8.52% to 34.49% across 80 blocks.
E.7 Historical masked full-block comparison
blocks.zh: E.7 历史掩盖的全块比较

blocks.en: These are the original causal QK-Wanda-M measurements, including the 80% failure regime; they are retained separately from the QK-Wanda comparison in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 这些是最初的因果QK-万达-M测量数据,包括80%的故障系统;它们与表3中的QK-万达比较分开保留.

blocks.en: Table 9: Pruning all seven transformer-block projections (QK/V/O and MLP gate/up/down), with embeddings and the output head excluded from the sparsity denominator. Wanda uses row budgets throughout; Wanda + QK-Wanda-M uses shared QK-Wanda-M only for QK and row-wise Wanda elsewhere. Accuracy is the seven-task mean (%); seed 0. Bold marks lower displayed PPL or higher accuracy at each sparsity, including ties.
blocks.zh: 表9:运行所有7个变压器区块预测(QK/V/O和MLP门/上/下),嵌入和输出头不包含在螺旋分母中. 万达使用全行预算;万达+QK-万达-. M使用共享的QK-万达-M只用于QK和别处的行形万达. 准确度是七任务平均值(%);种子0. 粗体标记下显示的 PPL 或更高精度 在每个螺旋,包括领带。

blocks.en: To test whether QK-Wanda-M remains useful as a component of broader pruning, we use it for QK while retaining Wanda on the value, output, and MLP projections. Table 9 compares this hybrid with Wanda throughout, using the same calibration and evaluation protocol. Here the requested sparsity applies to all seven block projections; embeddings, biases, normalization parameters, and the language-model head remain dense.
blocks.zh: 为了检验QK-旺达-M是否作为更广阔的普鲁姆的一部分仍然有用,我们把它用于QK,同时保留旺达的数值,输出和MLP预测. 表9用相同的校准和评价规程,将这种混合物与万达在整个过程中进行比较. 在此,要求的Sparsity适用于所有七个块的预测;嵌入、偏差、正常化参数和语言模型头仍然密集。

blocks.en: At 30% and 50%, the hybrid improved both PPL metrics on all three models ( Table 9 ). At 50%, TinyLlama WikiText-2/C4 PPL decreased from 11.52/13.85 to 11.22/13.62, with smaller relative gains on 7B/13B; mean accuracy increased by 0.19/0.86/0.15 points on TinyLlama/7B/13B. Thus, the QK-aware hybrid also helped at moderate full-block sparsity.
blocks.zh: 在30%和50%时,混合体改进了所有三种模型的PPL指标(表9)。 TinyLlama Wikitext-2/C4 PPL, 占50% 从11.52/13.85降至11.22/13.62,7B/13B的相对增益较小;TinyLlama/7B/13B的平均精度提高了0.19/0.86/0.15分。 因此,QK-aware型杂交车也帮助了中等的全区型垃圾邮件。

blocks.en: At 80% full-block sparsity, both pipelines degraded severely: PPL exceeded 1000 on 7B/13B, and mean accuracy remained below 36% on all three models. Relative differences in this failure regime do not indicate preservation of model quality.
blocks.zh: 80%的整块垃圾桶,两条管道严重退化:7B/13B的PPL超过1000,所有三种模型的平均精度都低于36%。 这种失败制度的相对差异并不表明模式质量得到维护。

blocks.en: Appendix F Calibration Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 附录F 校准 敏感性

blocks.en: The sample-count sensitivity experiment uses Llama-3.1-8B at 50% QK sparsity and seed 0, comparing row-wise Wanda with causal QK-Wanda-M. The context-length study extends the comparison to unmasked QK-Wanda and Llama-2-7B while holding the 524,288-token calibration pool, 50% QK sparsity, and seed 0 fixed. WikiText-2 test and C4 validation perplexities are evaluated at context length 2048.
blocks.zh: 采样计数敏感度实验使用Llama-3.1-8B在50%的QK孢子和种子0上,将顺行的旺达与因果QK-旺达-M进行对比. 上下文长度研究将比较范围延伸至未蒙面的QK-旺达和Llama-2-7B上,同时持有524,288个托肯校准池,50%的QK孢子和种子0固定. WikiText-2测试和C4验证偏差被评价为上下文长度2048.

blocks.en: Table 10 varies the number of length-2048 windows. Both methods were weakly sensitive to sample count. We selected a common N ∗ = 256 N_{*}=256 : all four PPL values were within 0.047% of their observed minima at N = 2048 N=2048 , which required eight times as many tokens. The WikiText-2/C4 improvements from 256 to 2048 windows were only 0.0020/0.0046 for Wanda and 0.0016/0.0003 for QK-Wanda-M.
blocks.zh: 表10 长度-2048年窗户数量不同. 这两种方法对抽样统计的敏感性都很低。 我们选择了一个通用的 N = 256 N = 256 :所有四个PPL值在N = 2048 N = 2048 的观测到的最小值的0.047%以内,这需要8倍多的代币. WikiText-2/C4从256个窗口改进到2048个窗口,万达仅0.0020/0.0046,QK-万达-M仅0.0016/0.0003.

blocks.en: Tables 11 and 12 hold the 524,288-token pool fixed and vary its segmentation. On Llama-3.1-8B, both causal QK-Wanda-M (M) and unmasked QK-Wanda attain their observed minima at T = 64 T=64 on both datasets. On Llama-2-7B, both variants attain their minima at T = 128 T=128 ; at T = 64 T=64 , each is within 0.0010 PPL of those minima. Llama-3.1-8B at T = 64 T=64 : unmasked minus causal PPL is -0.0011 on WikiText-2 and +0.0002 on C4; for Llama-2-7B at T = 64 T=64 : unmasked minus causal PPL is +0.0007 on WikiText-2 and -0.0007 on C4. The direction of the small masked–unmasked difference changes across model and dataset, so neither variant wins uniformly in this sensitivity test. The results support T = 64 T=64 as a stable operating point across these two checkpoints, but do not establish a universal optimum.
blocks.zh: 表11和表12固定了524,288个托肯池,并改变了它的分型。 在Llama-3.1-8B上,因果的QK-Wanda-M(M)和未蒙面的QK-Wanda在两个数据集上均在T=64 T=64上实现了观测到的迷你. 在Llama-2-7B上,两种变体在T = 128 T = 128时均达到其最小值;在T = 64 T = 64时,每个变体都在这些最小值的0.0010 PPL范围内。 Llama-3.1-8B at T=64 T=64 :在Wikitext-2上未蒙面的减因子PPL为-0.0011,在C4上为+0.0002;在Llama-2-7B at T=64 T=64 :在Wikitext-2上未蒙面的减因子PPL为+0.0007,在C4上为-0.0007. 小的蒙面-无遮面差异的方向在模型和数据集之间变化,因此两个变体在这个灵敏度测试中都无法统一获胜. 结果支持T=64 T=64作为穿越这两个检查站的稳定运行点,但没有建立普遍的最佳操作点.

blocks.en: Appendix G Additional Model Comparisons
blocks.zh: 附录G 模型比较

blocks.en: The tables report QK-only pruning under the common protocol in Sections 4 and E . They include QK-Wanda with separate and shared budgets, row-wise Wanda , and the explicitly labeled scoring variants. QK error follows Equation 49 ; mean zero-shot accuracy uses the seven tasks in Appendix E.2 . Full sparsity sweeps appear in Appendices I and J .
blocks.zh: 这些表格报告在4节和E节的共同协议下只检查QK。 它们包括有单独和共享预算的QK-万达(QK-Wanda),顺行的万达(Wanda),以及明确标注的评分变体. QK错误跟随第49条方程式;表示零射精度使用附录E.2中的7项任务. 在附录一和附录J中出现了完整的垃圾扫描。

blocks.en: Across all 15 checkpoints and nine nonzero sparsities, shared-budget QK-Wanda lowers QK error in 133/135 comparisons with Wanda, WikiText-2 PPL in 103/135, and C4 PPL in 101/135. Its mean zero-shot accuracy is higher in 30/45 comparisons. The aggregate tables below separate these results from those of QK-Wanda-M.
blocks.zh: 在所有15个检查站和9个非零垃圾点上,共享预算QK-万达在133/135与万达的比较中降低了QK错误,WikiText-2 PPL在103/135中降低了C4 PPL. 在30/45的比较中,它的平均零射精度更高. 以下表格将这些结果与QK-Wanda-M结果分开。

blocks.en: G.1 Llama 3
blocks.zh: G.1 拉马 3

blocks.en: Table 13 covers Llama-3.2-1B/3B and Llama-3.1-8B/70B. At 80% sparsity, QK-Wanda has higher PPL than Wanda on all four checkpoints, despite lower QK error on 1B, 8B, and 70B. The 3B checkpoint also has higher QK error at 80% and 90%. This family illustrates the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of downstream quality. QK-Wanda-MC and QK-Wanda-MRC test centering before and after RoPE; their objectives and results are discussed in Appendix O .
blocks.zh: 表13包括Llama-32-1B/3B和Llama-31-8B/70B。 尽管1B,8B和70B的QK错误较低,但QK-Wanda在所有四个检查站的PPL都比Wanda高80%. 3B检查站的QK误差也较高,分别为80%和90%. 这个家庭表明了当地重建作为下游质量预测器的局限性。 QK-Wanda-MC和QK-Wanda-MRC在RoPE前后的试验中心;其目标和结果在附录O中讨论.
