blocks.en: G.1.1 Zero-shot task performance
blocks.zh: G.1.1 零镜头任务业绩

blocks.en: Tables 19 and 21 report the individual task scores underlying Table 13 . At 80% sparsity, shared-budget QK-Wanda has lower mean accuracy than Wanda on 1B and 3B, but higher mean accuracy on 8B (60.61% versus 59.64%). On 70B, the means are close: 65.93% versus 66.64%, even though WikiText-2/C4 PPL rises from 4.98/9.89 to 18.89/32.59. Thus, the increase in language-model loss does not translate into an equally large change in task accuracy.
blocks.zh: 表19和表21报告了表13所列各项任务的分数。 1B和3B的共享预算QK-万达平均精度低于万达,但8B的平均精度较高(60.61%对59.64%)。 在70B上,途径接近:65.93%对66.64%,尽管Wikitext-2/C4 PPL从4.98/9.89上升到18.89/32.59. 因此,语文模型损失的增加不会导致任务准确性发生同样大的改变。

blocks.en: QK-Wanda-MRC improves the high-sparsity PPL of 3B and 8B relative to QK-Wanda, but its effect on task accuracy depends on the checkpoint. Appendix O.4 discusses these comparisons. All displayed variants use the same evaluation examples; differences between PPL and accuracy describe distinct measured outcomes.
blocks.zh: QK-万达-MRC比起QK-万达改进了3B和8B的高散PL,但其对任务准确性的影响取决于检查站. 附录O.4讨论了这些比较。 所有显示的变体都使用同样的评价实例;PPL和精度之间的差异说明了不同的计量结果.

blocks.en: G.2 TinyLlama and Llama 2
blocks.zh: G.2 提尼拉玛和拉玛 2

blocks.en: TinyLlama-1.1B is an independently trained 3-trillion-token checkpoint ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) , with 32 query heads and 4 key/value heads. Llama 2 7B/13B use MHA, while 70B uses GQA. Each checkpoint uses its native tokenizer; calibration tokens are identical across methods within that checkpoint.
blocks.zh: TinyLlama-1.1B是一个经过独立培训的3-trillion-token检查站(Zhang等人,2024a),有32个查询头和4个钥匙/值头。 Llama 2 7B/13B使用MHA,而70B使用GQA. 每个检查站都使用其本地的代号器;校准标志在该检查站内的各种方法相同。

blocks.en: At 80% sparsity, shared-budget QK-Wanda reduces WikiText-2/C4 PPL from 11.01/13.16 to 8.91/11.36 on TinyLlama, from 12.54/13.94 to 8.31/11.20 on Llama-2-7B, and from 4.55/6.91 to 3.63/5.97 on Llama-2-70B. The 13B checkpoint also improves on both datasets. These gains span MHA and GQA; they do not imply that attention architecture alone determines the benefit.

blocks.en: G.3 Qwen2.5

We evaluate seven Qwen2.5 base checkpoints from 0.5B to 72B ( Qwen et al., 2024 ) . All use GQA. Their QK projections include biases, which enter the score calculations and remain unchanged during pruning. The experiments use native tokenizers and the protocol in Sections 4 and E .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了7个Quen2.5基地检查站,从0.5B到72B(Quen等人,2024年)。 全部使用GQA. 他们的QK预测包括偏差,这些偏差进入计分计算,在打压期间保持不变. 实验中使用了原生的标注剂和4节和E节中的协议.

blocks.en: Table 15 reports the 0.5B–32B checkpoints. The PPL differences are generally small at moderate sparsity. At 80%, outcomes depend on the checkpoint and dataset: for example, QK-Wanda improves WikiText-2 PPL on 7B while slightly increasing C4 PPL, and increases both on 32B. Lower QK error therefore need not coincide with lower PPL. The full sweeps and allocation profiles appear in Appendices I.7 and E.6 .
blocks.zh: 表15报告0.5B-32B检查站。 在中度痉挛时,PPL差异一般很小. 80%的结果取决于检查点和数据集:例如,QK-Wanda在7B上改进了WikiText-2 PPL,同时略微增加了C4 PPL,同时在32B上都提高了. 因此,较低的QK错误不需要与较低的PPL重合. 全部扫描和分配概况载于附录一.7和E.6。

At 80%, shared-budget QK-Wanda lowers WikiText-2/C4 PPL from 4.55/9.87 to 4.23/9.52. Its mean zero-shot accuracy increases from 73.44% to 74.00%. Table 16 includes the matrix-budget Wanda control and the QK scoring variants.

blocks.en: G.3.1 Zero-shot task performance
blocks.zh: G.3.1 零射任务业绩

blocks.en: Tables 20 and 22 report all seven task scores for the dense checkpoints and the QK-only pruning configurations at 30%, 50%, and 80% sparsity. The weights evaluated for these tasks are the same pruned weights used for PPL; evaluation makes no further changes to them.
blocks.zh: 表20和表22显示所有7个任务分数都是密集的检查站和只使用QK的挤压配置,分别为30%、50%和80%。 为这些任务评价的权重与PPL所用的相同;评价对这些权重没有进一步的改变.

blocks.en: At 80%, shared-budget QK-Wanda raises mean accuracy on 1.5B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B, but lowers it on 0.5B and 3B. The PPL ordering differs in several cases: the 32B mean improves slightly despite higher PPL on both datasets. These results complement the checkpoint summaries rather than providing a single downstream ranking for the family.
blocks.zh: 在80%时,共享预算QK-Wanda提高1.5B,7B,14B,32B和72B的平均精度,但降低到0.5B和3B. PPL订购在几种情况下有所不同:32B表示略有改善,尽管两个数据集的PPL较高. 这些结果补充了检查站摘要,而不是为家庭提供单一的下游排名。

blocks.zh: G.4 描述性汇总比较

blocks.en: All counts compare unrounded values, exclude dense points, and are descriptive rather than independent statistical trials. Lower PPL/error or higher accuracy determines the favorable direction. The 135 sweep configurations comprise 15 checkpoints and nine sparsities; task evaluation uses the 45 configurations at 30%, 50%, and 80%.

blocks.en: Of the 135 shared-QK/row-Wanda comparisons, both PPL values decreased in 91, both increased in 26, and 18 had mixed signs. In 24 configurations, both PPL values increased despite lower QK error. Across the 315 individual task scores, 190 increased, 109 decreased, and 16 tied; tasks within a configuration are not independent replications.
blocks.zh: 在135个共享-QK/row-Wanda比较中,91年的PPL值都有所下降,26年都有所增加,18个迹象好坏参半。 在24个配置中,尽管QK错误较低,但两个PPL值都增加了. 在315项个人任务中,有190项增加,109项减少,16项捆绑;配置内的任务不是独立的复制。

blocks.en: We evaluated causal pre-RoPE scores with row-wise, separate matrix, and shared QK budgets, and the RoPE-aware scores from Appendix C with separate and shared budgets. All runs used the same checkpoint, frozen calibration tokens, context lengths, seed, FP16 precision, and ceiling rule for deletion counts. At sparsity ρ \rho , row-wise QK-Wanda-M removed exactly ⌈ 4096 ​ ρ ⌉ \lceil 4096\rho\rceil weights from every Q and K row, matching Wanda’s integer quotas. This control fixes allocation granularity while changing the score; causal scores need not preserve within-row rankings (Appendix B.4 ). Row-wise pruning and its PPL and zero-shot evaluations ran on NVIDIA H200 GPUs. The existing Wanda, separate/shared causal, and RoPE pruning sweeps ran on A100 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 我们用逐行、单独的矩阵和共享的QK预算评估了RoPE预分数,并用单独的共享预算评估了附录C的RoPE意识分数。 所有运行都使用相同的检查站,冻结的校准符,上下文长度,种子,FP16精度,以及删除计数的上限规则. QK-Wanda-M从每条Q和K行中完全删除了 QK-Wanda-M 的重量, 此控制在改变分数的同时修正分配颗粒性;因果分数不需要保留排行内排名(附录B.4 ). 在NVIDIA H200 GPU上运行着逐行浏览及其PPL和零镜头评价. 现存的万达,单独/共享因果,以及ROPE的普鲁士扫瞄在A100GPU上运行.

blocks.en: At 30%, 50%, and 80%, we replayed the saved masks for the seven zero-shot tasks in Appendix E.2 , including the original separate-budget causal masks. This table retains the causal QK diagnostic on common dense inputs: each block pools squared errors and reference energies over the allowed pairs in Equation 13 , and the block ratios are averaged as in Equation 49 ; it does not measure the RoPE-aware objective itself. These errors were evaluated on the original A100 hardware, with a repeated shared-budget control reproducing the published block-level errors. Table 23 includes all six methods and the dense reference.
blocks.zh: 以30%,50%,80%的速度,我们重新播放了附录E.2中七个零镜头任务的保存口罩,包括最初的单独预算因果口罩. 本表保留了常见密集输入的因果QK诊断:方程式13中每个区块池平方误差和准对的参考能量,区块比与方程式49中的平均比值;不测量RoPE-aware目标本身. 这些错误在原A100硬件上被评价,一个重复的共享预算控制复制已公布的块级错误. 表23包括所有六种方法和密集的参考。

blocks.en: Table 23: Scoring and budget ablation on Llama-2-7B with QK-only unstructured pruning. QK-Wanda-M uses causal pre-RoPE scores with row-wise, separate matrix, or shared QK budgets. QK-Wanda-MR additionally includes RoPE, with separate or shared budgets. Wanda uses row-wise budgets. This specialized ablation retains the historical causal pre-RoPE error: the block-relative squared norm uses only causally allowed pairs in both numerator and denominator. It is distinct from the full-product diagnostic in Equation 49 . Bold selects the best displayed result among six methods at each sparsity, including ties.
blocks.zh: 表23:Llama-2-7B上的分红和预算减值,只加QK型无结构的挤压. QK -旺达... M使用带有逐行,单独矩阵,或共享QK预算的因果预ROPE分数. QK-旺达-MR还包含ROPE,有单独或共享的预算. 万达采用逐行预算. 这种专门化的衰减保留了历史的因果前RoPE错误:块-相对平方规范在数字和分母中只使用因果允许的对. 它不同于第49条中的全产品诊断。 粗体选用最佳的显示结果在每条筋的六种方法中,包括领带.

blocks.en: Row-wise causal QK-Wanda-M closely tracked Wanda: absolute PPL differences were below 0.001 on both datasets through 60% sparsity. At 80%, its WikiText-2/C4 PPL was 12.51/13.90, compared with Wanda’s 12.54/13.94; at 90%, the differences remained below 0.10 and had opposite signs across datasets. Its mean zero-shot accuracy was lower by 0.05, 0.01, and 0.05 percentage points at 30%, 50%, and 80%, and its QK error was slightly higher at all three levels before rounding. Given the single seed and different GPU platforms for PPL and task evaluation, these small changes do not establish a reliable advantage from changing the score under fixed row quotas.
blocks.zh: 顺行因子QK-万达-M紧密跟踪万达:两个数据集的绝对PPL差异低于0.001,通过60%的sparsity. 其WikiText-2/C4 PPL在80%时为12.51/13.90,而Wanda的12.54/13.94;在90%时,差异仍然低于0.10,而且各数据集有相反的迹象。 它的平均零射精度低了0.05,0.01,以30%,50%,80%的分数0.05个百分点,它的QK误差在四舍五入前在所有三个级别都略高. 鉴于PPL和任务评价的单一种子和不同的GPU平台,这些小的改变并没有在固定行配额下改变分数建立可靠的优势.

blocks.en: Allowing the causal QK scores to redistribute deletions across rows had a much larger effect on this checkpoint. At 80%, separate and shared budgets achieved WikiText-2/C4 PPL of 8.32/11.17 and 8.33/11.21, respectively, and mean accuracy of 58.03% and 57.81%, versus 52.51% for row-wise QK-Wanda-M. Separate budgets slightly outperformed shared budgets at this sparsity and had lower QK error at all three tabulated sparsities; shared budgets achieved lower PPL at 30% and 50%. Thus, freeing the per-row quota mattered substantially here, while sharing the budget between Q and K was not uniformly better than separate matrix budgets.
blocks.zh: 允许因果的QK分数跨行再分配删除,对这个检查站的影响要大得多. 在80%时,单独和共享预算分别实现了8.32/11.17和8.33/11.21的Wikitext-2/C4PPL,平均准确度为58.03%和57.81%,对行式QK-Wanda-M来说,分别为52.51%。 单项预算在这种抽筋中略高于共享预算,在所有三个列表抽筋中QK误差都较低;共享预算实现30%和50%的PPPL更低。 因此,释放每组的配额在这里具有重大意义,同时在Q和K之间分担预算并不统一好于单独的矩阵预算。

blocks.en: Adding RoPE did not consistently improve perplexity. At matched budgets, it lowered WikiText-2 PPL at 3 of 9 nonzero sparsities for separate budgets and 2 of 9 for shared budgets; on C4, it improved 3 of 9 for each budget. Below 40% sparsity, all absolute changes were smaller than 0.001 PPL. From 40% through 80%, RoPE increased PPL on both datasets for both budgets. At 90%, however, it reduced WikiText-2/C4 PPL from 29.23/40.29 to 26.66/36.40 with separate budgets and from 30.14/41.90 to 27.19/37.14 with a shared budget. Thus, RoPE helped at the most aggressive pruning level, despite being slightly worse over the intermediate range.
blocks.zh: 添加RoPE并不能始终提高迷惑性。 在相应的预算中,它将WikiText-2 PPL降低到单独预算的9个非零边框中的3个和共同预算的9个;在C4中,它提高了每个预算的9个中的3个。 在40%的螺旋性以下,所有绝对变化都小于0.001 PPL. 从40%到80%,这两个预算都增加了PPL。 然而,它将WikiText-2/C4 PPL从29.23/40.29减少到2666/36.40, 单独预算从30.14/41.90减少到27.19/37.14, 共同预算。 因此,ROPE在最激烈的打压水平上有所帮助,尽管在中间范围上稍有恶化.

blocks.en: Zero-shot changes were small and mixed. At a matched shared budget, adding RoPE changed mean accuracy by − 0.03 -0.03 , + 0.10 +0.10 , and + 0.01 +0.01 percentage points at 30%, 50%, and 80% sparsity, respectively. At 80%, RoPE with separate budgets achieved 58.13%, compared with 57.82% for RoPE with a shared budget. Both RoPE variants had higher pre-RoPE QK error than the shared causal method at all three tabulated sparsities, while retaining lower error than Wanda. This comparison concerns a common pre-RoPE diagnostic, not whether the RoPE-aware objective was better preserved. Within this causal ablation, RoPE helps at 90% sparsity but does not provide a consistent improvement across the sweep.
blocks.zh: 零镜头的变化很小,而且有好有坏。 在匹配的共享预算中,加上ROPE,平均精度分别改变为−0.03-0.03,+0.10+0.10,+0.01+0.01个百分点,分别以30%,50%和80%的伸缩度. 预算单列的劳动与就业部达到80%,达到58.13%,而预算单列的劳动与就业部达到57.82%。 这两种RoPE变体都比所有三种制表的Sparsities的共享因果法有更高的前ROPE QK差错,同时保留了比Wanda更低的差错. 这一比较涉及一个常见的RoPE前诊断,而不是RoPE认识目标是否得到更好的保存. 在这种因果减退中,ROPE帮助了90%的垃圾,但并没有在整个扫荡过程中提供一致的改善.

blocks.en: K.2 Why re-scoring is not a greedy teacher-loss optimizer

blocks.en: The scalar proof applies around the current pair. It measures the squared local change caused by the next deletion, rather than its marginal effect on reconstruction of the original reference. Using the unscaled products B = Q ⊤ ​ K B=Q^{\top}K from Section B.2 , for each sequence and head let E = B current − B ref E=B_{\mathrm{current}}-B_{\mathrm{ref}} be the accumulated error, and let Δ ​ B = B next − B current \Delta B=B_{\mathrm{next}}-B_{\mathrm{current}} be the next change. blocks.en: The one-shot rows also compare scoring rules at fixed allocation granularity. With 128 × 2048 128\times 2048 calibration, causal QK-Wanda-M improves both PPL values over Wanda; with 256 × 32 256\times 32 , it slightly worsens WikiText-2 and improves C4. Causal weighting can change rankings within a row (Appendix B.4 ), unlike the single-sequence unmasked row rescaling. These controls show a calibration-dependent scoring effect at one checkpoint and sparsity; they do not isolate how much of the main cross-model gains comes from scoring versus allocation.

blocks.en: Under row budgets, QK-Wanda-M schedules differ by less than 0.0012 PPL within each calibration setting, while ten-step pruning takes 3.6–3.8 times as long as one-shot QK-Wanda-M . These single-seed results provide no evidence of a useful quality gain.

blocks.en: Under matrix-global budgets, additional steps worsen both perplexities. At length 32, one to ten steps raises WikiText-2/C4 PPL by 0.4873 / 1.3771 0.4873/1.3771 ; at length 2048, by 1.0570 / 2.6553 1.0570/2.6553 . The data favor one-shot pruning in this ablation. They do not identify whether irreversible mask allocation, omitted residual terms, or other interactions cause the degradation, and do not rule out other adaptive algorithms.

blocks.en: The contribution is the compensation-free elementwise pruning specialization, its exact GQA-aware scalar statistics, and its controlled evaluation, including causal and rotary-aware extensions. The cited prior methods do not instantiate this full procedure. The quadratic connection above identifies which underlying ideas are shared and which compression decision and accumulators are studied here.
blocks.zh: 其贡献是无报酬要素的推算专门化、其准确的GQA-感知分级统计及其可控评价,包括因果和旋转感知扩展。 所引用的先前方法并不能立即使整个程序迅速生效。 上面的四极连接确定了哪些基本想法是共享的,哪些压缩决定和积分在此进行研究.

blocks.en: Appendix M Cost of QK Pruning
blocks.zh: 附录 M QK Pruning的费用

blocks.en: We measure the full QK pruning computation on NVIDIA A100 PCIe 40GB and H200 GPUs across four Llama 3 model sizes. Tables 26 and 27 report medians of five runs for row-wise Wanda and shared-budget QK-Wanda . The unweighted means of the four checkpoint-specific time ratios are 1.01 on A100 and 1.03 on H200. Individual ratios range from 1.00 to 1.02 on A100 and from 1.01 to 1.08 on H200.
blocks.zh: 我们在NVIDIA A100 PCIe 40GB和H200 GPU上测量了全QK的推算,跨越四个Llama 3模型大小. 表26和27报告按行顺序排列的旺达和共用预算QK-旺达的中间值为5。 四个检查站具体时间比率的未加权办法分别为A100为1.01,H200为1.03。 个人比率在A100为1.00至1.02,在H200为1.01至1.08。

blocks.en: Each timed block includes calibration forward passes, fresh statistics accumulation, score construction, stable GPU sorting and mask selection, weight zeroing, and forward propagation through the pruned block. Thus, both selection and application of the mask are included. Timers exclude checkpoint loading, tokenization and initial calibration-input preparation, initial model/input placement, benchmark-only restoration of the original weights, and evaluation. These measurements cover pruning computation, rather than end-to-end wall time including loading and transfers. The complexity column covers QK projections and scoring only; sorting the shared pool of P = d ⁡ ( D Q + D K ) P=d(D_{Q}+D_{K}) scores adds O ⁡ ( P ​ log ⁡ P ) O(P\log P) comparison-sort complexity and is included in the measured times. Wanda sorts each output row separately.
blocks.zh: 每个定时区块包括校准前方通行证,新鲜统计累积,分数构建,稳定的GPU排序和面具选择,重量零化,以及通过pruned区块进行前方传播. 因此,面具的选择和应用都包括在内。 计时器排除了检查站加载,标注和初始校准-输入准备,初始模型/输入投放,仅以基准方式恢复原重量,以及评价. 这些测量包括推算,而不是包括加载和转移在内的端到端墙时间。 复杂性栏只涵盖QK预测和评分;排序共享的P=dQQ(DQ+DK)集合. P=d(D_{Q}+D_{K})的分数增加了O (Plog ⁡P)O(P\log P)的比较类复杂度,并包含在测量时间中. Wanda将每个输出行分别排序.

blocks.en: Both GPUs use the same pinned Llama-3.2-1B/3B and Llama-3.1-8B/70B checkpoints in FP16, 8192 × 64 = 524,288 8192\times 64=524{,}288 C4 calibration tokens with seed 0, sequence batch size 32, FP32 statistics, and disabled TF32. These are the saved token manifests, sequence length and batching used in the main pruning experiments. Mask selection uses stable sorting on GPU. We prune only query and key weights at 50% sparsity: Wanda uses row quotas, and QK-Wanda shares the budget across the two projections. Each method follows its own sequentially pruned calibration trajectory; the last measured output is propagated to its next block. They start from the same dense checkpoint and initial calibration inputs; later blocks receive the outputs of that method’s pruned preceding blocks.
blocks.zh: 两个GPU在FP16,8192×64 = 524,288 8192\times 64=524{,}288 C4 校准标志上都使用相同的钉住的Llama-32-1B/3B和Llama-31-8B/70B检查站,序列批量大小为32,FP32统计,并禁用TF32. 这些是主要钻探实验中使用的已保存的符号表,序列长度和批量. 面具选择在GPU上使用稳定的排序. 我们只以50%的倾斜度进行查询和关键加权: 万达使用排位配额,QK-万达在两项预测中分担预算. 每种方法都遵循自己的顺序校准轨迹;最后测量的输出被推广到它的下一个区块. 他们从同一密集的检查站和初步校准输入开始;后来的区块收到该方法在前几个区块的输出。

blocks.en: The checkpoint remains on CPU with one block moved to GPU. Initial calibration-input placement and block-weight transfers take place outside the measured intervals. Each actual block has two warm-ups and five timed repetitions per method, with method order alternating by block and CUDA synchronization around every measurement. Original query and key weights are restored outside the timer before each repetition. We sum the actual block times for each repetition before taking the median; no times are extrapolated from one layer. The average ratio is the unweighted mean of the four ratios of method-specific medians.
blocks.zh: 检查站仍在CPU上,其中一个街区被移到GPU. 初步校准-输入放置和块重转移在测量间隔之外进行。 每个实际区块每个方法有两次热身和五次计时重复,方法顺序由区块和CUDA在每次测量前后的同步交替. 原始查询和按键权重在每次重复前在计时器外恢复. 我们在取中位数之前对每次重复的实际块时间进行总和;不从一层推算时间。 平均比率是方法特定中位数的四个比率的未加权平均值。

blocks.en: An independent audit reaggregates all five sums over the complete block sequence, checks frozen source and checkpoint revisions, and verifies the saved calibration-token segments. Table 28 reports repetition ranges; five repeats quantify timing variability. Full repetition sums, calibration receipts, protocol and source hashes are retained in results/full_pruning_cost.json ; detailed per-block timing records are preserved in output/full_pruning_cost_gpu_20261001/ .
blocks.zh: 独立审计将全部5笔款项按整块顺序重新汇总,检查冻结源头和检查站的修订,并核实节省下来的校准点。 表28 报告重复范围;5次重复量化时间变化。 完全重复总和、校准收据、协议和源散列保留在结果/full_pruning_cost.json中;每个块的详细计时记录保留在输出/full_pruning_cost_gpu_20261001/ 中。

blocks.en: Appendix N Wanda with Matrix-Wide Budgets
blocks.zh: 附录 N Wanda 和矩阵预算

blocks.en: This appendix retains the matched-budget comparison with QK-Wanda-M on the three 70B/72B checkpoints. Wanda uses a separate budget for each complete query and key projection. The corresponding QK-Wanda curves appear in Appendix I , and the main shared-budget comparison in Table 2 . Every projection matched the corresponding separate QK-Wanda-M run’s integer deletion count. Checkpoints, tokenizers, seed 0, 524,288 calibration tokens segmented into length-64 sequences, and PPL context 2048 were fixed. H200 runs used FP16 for Llama and BF16 for Qwen. Biases and non-QK weights remained dense.
blocks.zh: 本附录保留了三个70B/72B检查站与QK-Wanda-M的对应预算比较。 万达对每一个完整的查询和密钥投影使用单独的预算. 相应的QK-万达曲线载于附录一,主要分担预算比较载于表2。 每个投影都对应相应的单独的QK-万达-M运行的整数删除计数. 检查点,标注器,种子0,524,288 校准符分解为长度-64序列,PPL上下文2048被固定. H200运行在Llama使用FP16,在Quen使用BF16. 双子体和非QK重量仍然很重。

blocks.en: Pruning was sequential across blocks: sampled tokens matched, while later activations could differ because of earlier masks. QK error used common dense inputs and the original 16 held-out C4 sequences of length 512; each pass reproduced the published 50% shared-mask anchor. Table 29 compares the scores under identical budgets. QK-Wanda-M produced lower measured WikiText-2/C4 PPL in nine/nine of nine configurations on Llama 2, seven/four on Llama 3, and five/seven on Qwen; QK error was lower in all 27. At 80% on Qwen, matrix-Wanda had lower PPL than separate QK-Wanda-M despite larger QK error; the C4 difference is hidden by rounding.
blocks.zh: Pruning是按顺序跨块排列的:样本的令牌匹配,而后来的激活可能因早期的口罩而有所不同. QK错误使用了常见的密集输入和最初的16个悬停的长度为512的C4序列;每次传球都转载了已公布的50%的共享掩码锚. 表29比较了相同预算下的分数。 QK -旺达... M在Llama 2, 7/4, Quen 5/7上的9个配置中,生产了测量较低的WikiText-2/C4 PPL;QK错误在所有27个配置中都较低. Quen上为80%,matrium-Wanda的PPL比单独的QK-Wanda-M低,尽管QK错误较大;C4差异通过四舍五入隐藏.

blocks.en: N.1 Zero-shot results
blocks.zh: N.1 零射出的结果

blocks.en: Table 30 reports the seven full task splits using the exact saved masks at 30%, 50%, and 80%. Evaluation documents and prompts matched the original comparison. Relative to row-wise Wanda, the matrix control improved the mean in three of nine configurations and worsened it in six. Shared QK-Wanda-M improved over the matrix control in six of nine, but lost on Llama 2 70B at 50% and Qwen2.5-72B at 30%/50%. At 80% on Llama-3.1-70B, the matrix control had lower PPL than shared QK-Wanda-M but much lower mean accuracy (57.74% versus 66.45%). Separate-budget QK-Wanda-M was not included in this task table, so the accuracy comparison does not isolate the scoring rule. All results use one calibration seed, and small differences do not establish statistical significance.
blocks.zh: 表30显示,7项任务用确切的保存口罩分开,分别为30%、50%和80%。 评价文件和提示与原始比较相符。 相对于行向的万达,矩阵控制在9个配置中的3个改进了平均值,在6个配置中恶化. 共享QK-万达-M在9个中6个改进了矩阵控制,但在Llama 2 70B上以50%的成绩输掉,Quen2.5-72B上以30%/50%的成绩输掉. 在Llama-3.1-70B的80%时,矩阵控制PPL比共享的QK-Wanda-M低得多,但平均精度却低得多(57.74%对66.45%)。 单独预算QK-万达-M没有列入本任务表,因此准确性比较并不孤立评分规则. 所有结果都使用一个校准种子,小差异并不能确定统计意义.

Wanda uses row budgets; Wanda (matrix) ranks weights within each projection; QK-Wanda-M uses shared QK budgets. Each section reuses the same dense reference and evaluation examples. Bold marks the highest displayed sparse score at each sparsity, including ties; Avg. is the unweighted seven-task mean.

blocks.en: Appendix O Centering the Causal Reconstruction Error
blocks.zh: 附录O 将因果重建错误中心化

blocks.en: Softmax is unchanged when the same constant is added to all allowed logits of a query. This motivates testing whether the pruning objective benefits from ignoring such shifts. We retain the causal, pre-RoPE setting of Equation 9 and denote the centered variant by QK-Wanda-MC . Centering is performed separately for each query token, over its allowed key positions; future keys never enter the mean.
blocks.zh: 当一个查询的所有允许的日志中添加相同的常数时,Softmax不变. 这促使人们检验这种不理会这种转变是否有利于追求目标。 我们保留了9号方程式的因果, 在每个查询符上,在允许的密钥位置上分别进行居中;未来的密钥从不输入平均值.

blocks.en: O.2 Llama 3 results
blocks.zh: O.2 Llama 3项结果

blocks.en: The comparison used the same checkpoints, calibration tokens, seed, sparsities, and evaluation data as the original experiments. Centered pruning and evaluation ran on NVIDIA H200 GPUs. Tables 13 and 19 add the centered results for Llama-3.2-1B/3B and Llama-3.1-8B. Their PPL and reconstruction curves appear in Appendices I and J . The reconstruction columns use the common QK diagnostic in Equation 49 , rather than the centered scoring loss.
blocks.zh: 比较使用了相同的检查站、校准标志、种子、抽筋和评价数据作为原始实验。 以NVIDIA H200 GPU为中心运行并进行评估。 表13和19增加了Llama-3.2-1B/3B和Llama-31-8B的中心结果。 他们的PPL和重建曲线出现在附录I和J中. 重建栏在方程式49中采用常见的QK诊断法,而不是中心评分损失.

blocks.en: At 30%, 50%, and 80% sparsity, centering increased both PPL metrics and the common full QK error on all three checkpoints relative to shared-budget QK-Wanda-M . For example, at 50% on 1B, WikiText-2/C4 PPL increased from 10.65/16.24 to 16.46/28.93. Zero-shot changes were mixed at 30%: mean accuracy increased from 54.28% to 54.43% on 1B and from 69.40% to 69.60% on 8B, but decreased from 61.55% to 61.35% on 3B. At 50% and 80%, all three checkpoints had lower mean accuracy with centering.
blocks.zh: 相对于共享预算QK-Wanda-M, 所有三个检查站的PPL度量和常见的全QK误差均以30%、50%和80%为中心。 例如,在 1B 上为 50%, Wikitext-2/C4 PPL 从10.65/16.24增加到16.46/28.93。 零镜头变化混合为30%:1B的平均精度从54.28%提高到54.43%,8B的精度从69.40%提高到69.60%,但3B的精度从61.55%下降到61.35%. 在50%和80%时,所有三个检查站的中间位置均差。

blocks.en: Thus, removing row-constant error from this proxy did not improve the tabulated PPL results. Softmax invariance alone does not guarantee a better pruning criterion: the proxy remains pre-RoPE and describes individual deletions, while the final mask removes many weights jointly. Within this causal comparison, centering alone did not provide a PPL advantage on these Llama 3 checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 因此,从这个代理中移除行恒定错误并没有改进列表的PPL结果. 光是软max invariance并不能保证更好的推力标准:代理仍然保留预ROPE并描述个人删除,而最终的掩码会联合去除许多重量. 在这一因果关系比较中,单靠中央并不能为这些Llama 3检查站提供PPL优势。

blocks.en: O.3 TinyLlama, Llama 2, and Qwen2.5 results
blocks.zh: O.3 TinyLlama、Llama 2和Qun2.5结果

blocks.en: We repeated the centered comparison on TinyLlama-1.1B, Llama-2-7B/13B, and Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B, preserving each checkpoint’s original calibration and evaluation protocol. Tables 14 and 15 include PPL, mean accuracy, and reconstruction error at 30%, 50%, and 80% sparsity; Tables 19 and 20 give all seven task scores. The corresponding appendix curves cover 0–90% sparsity, reusing the dense references. The reconstruction metric is the same as above.
blocks.zh: 我们重复了对TinyLlama-1.1B、Llama-2-7B/13B和Qun2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B的中心比较,保留了每个检查站最初的校准和评价协议。 表14和15包括PPL,平均精确度,重建误差为30%,50%和80%;表19和20给出了全部七个任务分数. 相应的附录曲线覆盖0~90%的螺旋,重用稠密的引用. 重建的衡量标准与上文相同。

blocks.en: Compared with shared-budget QK-Wanda-M , centering increased both PPL metrics at every nonzero sparsity on TinyLlama and Llama-2-13B. Outcomes on Qwen2.5 were mixed. At 80% on 0.5B, WikiText-2/C4 PPL improved from 15.07/23.07 to 14.73/22.76, and mean accuracy increased from 47.01% to 47.37%. On 7B, WikiText-2 PPL improved at all nine nonzero sparsities, often only slightly, whereas C4 improved at three. Across these seven checkpoints and nine sparsities, centering lowered WikiText-2 PPL in 19 of 63 comparisons and C4 PPL in 8 of 63.
blocks.zh: 与共享预算QK-Wanda-M相比,在TinyLlama和Llama-2-13B上的每条非零垃圾中,以PPL指标为中心。 关于Quen2.5的结果好坏参半。 在 0.5B 上为 80%, Wikitext-2/C4 PPL 平均精度从47.01%提高到47.37%。 在7B上,WikiText-2 PPL在全部9个非零相片上都有改进,往往只有微小的改善,而C4在3个时有改进. 通过这7个检查站和9个垃圾堆,在63个比较中的19个和63个中的8个比较中的C4 PPL中心降低了WikiText-2 PPL。

blocks.en: Mean zero-shot accuracy improved in 9 of the 21 tabulated comparisons and declined in 12. For example, Llama-2-13B had slightly higher accuracy at all three tabulated sparsities despite higher PPL; Qwen2.5-3B at 80% improved from 61.50% to 62.76% accuracy while C4 PPL worsened from 16.08 to 16.51. The common full QK error increased in 62 of 63 comparisons. Thus centering sometimes helped downstream metrics, but did not provide a consistent improvement across checkpoints, sparsities, or datasets. These are single-calibration-seed comparisons.
blocks.zh: 在21个列表比较中,有9个提高了平均零射精度,12个下降了。 例如,尽管PPL较高,Llama-2-13B在所有三个制表式垃圾邮件的精度都略高;Quen2.5-3B的精度从61.50%提高到62.76%,而C4 PPL的精度则从16.08上升到16.51。 常见的全QK错误在63个比较中的62个增加了. 因此,中心有时有助于下游的衡量标准,但并没有提供跨越检查站、垃圾堆或数据集的一致改进。 这些是单一校准种子的比较。

blocks.zh: O.4 在旋转位置嵌入后居中

blocks.en: We average these costs over calibration sequences and apply the same shared QK budget, with the common 1 / m 1/m scaling used by the other implementations. Setting all rotary maps to the identity recovers Equations 62 and 63 . For RoPE, each R t ​ e i R_{t}e_{i} is supported on one rotary coordinate pair, so only 2 × 2 2\times 2 prefix covariances are needed in these contractions. Prefix first and second moments compute them without forming a T × T T\times T logit matrix. We use the model’s actual rotary maps, including its frequency scaling, and the same stabilized prefix accumulation as above. Independent tests compare every scalar score against explicit deletion and centering of the full causal product error.
blocks.zh: 我们在校准序列上平均计算这些费用,并采用相同的共享QK预算,其他执行所使用的通用1 / m 1/m缩放。 为身份设定所有旋转图可回收62和63等方程式。 对ROPE来说,每个R t e i R_{t}e_{i}都是在一个旋转坐标对上支持的,所以在这些收缩中只需要2×2 2\times 2的前缀共变. 前缀第一秒和第二秒在不形成T×T\times T logit矩阵的情况下计算它们. 我们使用模型的实际旋转图,包括它的频率缩放,以及和上面相同的稳定前缀积累. 独立测试将每个分数与全部因果产品错误的明确删除和中心化相比较.

blocks.en: O.5 Post-RoPE centered results on Llama 3
blocks.zh: O.5 以Llama 3为中心roPE后结果

blocks.en: We evaluated QK-Wanda-MRC on the same Llama-3.2-1B/3B and Llama-3.1-8B checkpoints, calibration sequences, sparsity grid, and evaluation data. Tables 13 and 19 report the summary and seven-task results; Appendices I and J include its full curves. The reconstruction columns again use the common QK diagnostic, rather than the new centered objective.
blocks.zh: 我们在同一Llama-3.2-1B/3B和Llama-31-8B检查站上评价了QK-Wanda-MRC、校准序列、垃圾网和评价数据。 表13和19报告汇总结果和7项任务结果;附录一和J包括其全部曲线。 重建栏再次使用常见的QK诊断,而不是新的中心目标.

blocks.en: At 80% sparsity, the combined RoPE-centered variant improved both PPL metrics and mean zero-shot accuracy over ordinary shared-budget QK-Wanda-M on 3B and 8B. On 3B, WikiText-2/C4 PPL decreased from 42.70/44.30 to 23.18/33.50, and accuracy increased from 50.16% to 52.88%. On 8B, PPL decreased from 13.81/22.36 to 12.51/19.95, and accuracy increased from 60.40% to 61.81%. Both checkpoints still had higher PPL than original row-wise Wanda at this sparsity. Compared with pre-RoPE centering, the 3B variant improved both PPL metrics at all nine nonzero sparsities.
blocks.zh: 在80%的sparsity时,以RoPE为中心的综合变体在3B和8B上比普通共享预算QK-Wanda-M改进了PPL的度量和平均零射精度. 在 3B 上, Wikitext -2/C4 PPL 从42.70/44.30降至23.18/33.50,准确率从50.16%增至52.88%。 8B时,PPL从13.81/22.36降至12.51/19.95,精度从60.40%增至61.81%. 这两个检查站的PPL仍高于原来在这种垃圾堆中排行的Wanda。 与RoPE前置中心相比,3B变体改进了所有9个非零的PL度量衡.

blocks.en: The gains were not uniform. At 30% and 50%, RoPE-centered PPL was higher than ordinary QK-Wanda-M on both datasets for all three checkpoints. The 1B regression at 50% was substantial: WikiText-2/C4 PPL rose from 10.65/16.24 to 22.63/46.81, and mean accuracy fell from 53.51% to 51.07%. Across the three checkpoints and nine nonzero sparsities, RoPE-centering lowered WikiText-2 PPL in 8 of 27 comparisons, C4 PPL in 7 of 27, and the common full QK error in 4 of 27. Mean zero-shot accuracy improved in 4 of the 9 tabulated comparisons. Thus the combination recovered some high-sparsity quality on 3B/8B, but these results do not show a consistent advantage over QK-Wanda-M across the tested settings.
blocks.zh: 收益并不一致。 在三个检查站的两个数据集中,以ROPE为中心的PPL都高于普通QK-Wanda-M。 1B回归率为50%是实质性的: Wikitext-2/C4 PPL 平均准确度从53.51%下降到51.07%。 在3个检查站和9个非零垃圾点上,RoPE-centering在27个比较中的8个降低了WikiText-2 PPL,在27个比较中的7个降低了C4 PPL,在27个比较中的4个降低了常见的全QK错误. 9个制表比较中的4个提高了平均零射精度。 因此,该组合在3B/8B上恢复了一些高的散热质量,但这些结果并没有显示在经过测试的设置中,与QK-万达-M相比具有一致的优势.

blocks.en: O.6 Post-RoPE centering across all model families
blocks.zh: O.6 以所有模范家庭为中心的后生殖健康方案

blocks.en: We extended the same post-RoPE centered score to all 15 checkpoints, including Llama-2-70B, Llama-3.1-70B, and Qwen2.5-72B. The existing appendix summary and task tables include these measurements, and the PPL and QK-error figures include the full sparsity sweeps. Checkpoint revisions, calibration tokens, precision, evaluation data, and shared QK budgets match the original controls. QK error follows the same diagnostic in Equation 49 .
blocks.zh: 我们把所有15个检查站,包括Llama-2-70B、Llama-3.1-70B和Qun2.5-72B,都以同样的ROPE为中心。 现有的附录摘要和任务表包括了这些测量,PPL和QK-error数字包括了全垃圾扫描. 检查点修改,校准符,精确度,评价数据,共享的QK预算与原始控制匹配. QK 错误在方程式 49 中遵循相同的诊断.

blocks.en: The downstream effect depends strongly on sparsity. Relative to the ordinary causal score, post-RoPE centering lowered WikiText-2/C4 PPL on 12/10 of the 15 checkpoints at 80% sparsity, but on only 3/0 at 50% and 2/1 at 30%. Across all 135 nonzero model–sparsity pairs, the corresponding counts were 53 and 41. These counts use unrounded values and include small differences.
blocks.zh: 下游效应严重依赖于痉挛. 相对于普通的因果分数,ROPE中心化后在15个检查站中的12/10将WikiText-2/C4 PPL降低到80%的sparsity,但仅以3/0降低到50%,2/1降低到30%. 在所有135个非零模型中,相对数分别为53和41。 这些计数使用未四舍五入的值,包括小的差别.

blocks.en: The largest models illustrate the mixed outcome. At 80% sparsity, Llama-3.1-70B improved from 18.98/32.37 to 13.67/22.61 WikiText-2/C4 PPL. Llama-2-70B instead worsened from 3.63/5.97 to 3.85/6.27. Qwen2.5-72B improved WikiText-2 from 4.244 to 4.186 while C4 changed from 9.523 to 9.527. Thus the combined variant can recover high-sparsity quality, especially on Llama 3, but is not uniformly better. Appendix P separates the contributions of masking, rotation, and centering and compares them with QK-Wanda.
blocks.zh: 最大的模型说明结果参差不齐。 在80%的sparsity,Llama-31-70B从18.98/32.37改进为13.67/22.61 Wikitext-2/C4 PPL. 相反,Llama-2-70B从3.63/5.97恶化到3.85/6.27。 Wen2.5-72B改进了Wikitext-2,从4.244改进为4.186,而C4则从9.523改为9.527. 因此,结合的变体可以恢复高的散热质量,特别是在Llama 3上,但并不统一更好. 附 录 P将蒙面,旋转,和中心的贡献分开,并与QK-Wanda进行比较.

blocks.en: Appendix P Choice of scoring variant
blocks.zh: 附录 P 评分变量的选择

blocks.en: We compare all eight combinations of three choices in the reconstruction objective: causal versus unrestricted query–key pairs, pre- versus post-RoPE products, and uncentered versus centered error. Centering subtracts the mean error over the eligible key positions separately for each query. With RoPE, this operation is applied after rotation. The switches are M (causal mask), R (RoPE), and C (centering), with the canonical method names listed in the tables. These choices change the pruning scores; the model’s attention computation is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了重建目标中三个选择的所有八个组合:因果关系与不受限制的查询 — — 键对、前对后ROPE产品,以及无中心与中心错误。 居中减去每个查询中符合条件的关键位置的平均错误。 与ROPE一起,此操作在旋转后应用. 开关为M(因果口罩)、R(ROPE)和C(中心),表格中列有犬类方法名称。 这些选择会改变分数;模型的注意力计算不变.

blocks.en: Appendices B , C.2 , and O derive the masked variants. Their unrestricted counterparts include all key positions: set the pair mask to one in the RoPE formulas, and replace each causal prefix by the full key sequence in the centered formulas. This gives R, C, and RC under the same individual-deletion principle as QK-Wanda.
blocks.zh: 附录B,C.2,O衍生出蒙面变体. 它们不受限制的对应物包括所有关键位置:在ROPE公式中将配对面罩设为一个,并将每个因果前缀替换为中心公式中的全部密钥序列. 这就使得R,C,和RC在与QK-Wanda相同的个人删除原则下.

blocks.en: The initial comparison uses Llama-2-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B at 50% and 80% sparsity. All variants share the same QK budget, checkpoint revision, calibration tokens, numerical precision, and WikiText-2/C4 evaluation protocol. All eight variants are complete. Table 31 reports PPL and seven-task mean accuracy.
blocks.zh: 最初的比较使用Llama-2-7B,Llama-31-8B,和Quen2.5-7B,分别以50%和80%的溅射率. 所有变体共用相同的QK预算,检查站修订,校准符,数字精度,以及Wikitext-2/C4评价协议. 所有八种变体皆成. 表31报告了PPL和7项任务的平均准确性。

blocks.en: Table 31: Eight scoring combinations on 7–8B models: causal mask (M), RoPE (R), and centering (C). QK variants share a QK budget; Wanda uses row-wise budgets. Dense (0%) is repeated as a reference. Avg. is the mean seven-task zero-shot accuracy (%). Bold marks the lowest available PPL among QK variants (displayed ties included). Attention itself is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 表31:7–8B型机车上的8个积分组合:因果面具(M),ROPE(R),和中枢(C). QK变体共享QK预算;万达采用逐行预算. ense(0%)作为参考重复. Avg.是平均七任务零射精度(%). 粗体标出在QK变体中可获得的PPL最低(包含分解关系). 注意本身没有变化。

blocks.en: At 80% sparsity, QK-Wanda-RC , post-RoPE centering without a causal mask, achieves the lowest PPL among QK variants on both datasets for Llama-2-7B (8.038/10.821). For Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, the lowest values instead come from QK-Wanda-MRC , post-RoPE centering with a causal mask (12.515/19.954 and 7.262/12.480, respectively). Thus the preferred masking choice depends on the checkpoint even when rotation and centering are fixed.
blocks.zh: 在80%的sparsity,QK-Wanda-RC,后ROPE中心无因果面具,在Llama-2-7B(8.038/10.821)两个数据集的QK变体中实现最低的PPL. 对于Llama-3.1-8B和Quen2.5-7B,最低值则来自QK-Wanda-MRC,后ROPE中心为因果面具(分别为12.515/19.954和7.262/12.480). 因此,即使旋转和中心固定,偏好伪装的选择也取决于检查站。

blocks.en: The ranking changes at 50% sparsity: QK-Wanda gives the lowest PPL among QK variants on both datasets for Llama-2-7B, while the differences among several Qwen variants are small. Pre-RoPE centering substantially worsens the 80% results on both Llama checkpoints. These comparisons show that the three choices interact, rather than providing independent, uniformly beneficial corrections.
blocks.zh: 排名变化为50%sparsity:QK-Wanda为Llama-2-7B的两个数据集给出了QK变体中最低的PPL,而几个Quen变体之间的差异很小. 以《议定书》为中心之前,两个Llama检查站的80%的检查结果严重恶化。 这些比较表明,这三种选择是相互作用的,而不是提供独立、统一有益的更正。

blocks.en: The extended comparison adds Llama-2-70B, Llama-3.1-70B, and Qwen2.5-72B at the same two sparsities and evaluates all six checkpoints on the same seven zero-shot tasks. All 96 PPL configurations and 96 zero-shot configurations are independently validated, including compatible reused measurements. Tables 31 and 32 report all results. The lowest-PPL and highest zero-shot variants differ across checkpoints and sparsity levels, so no single combination dominates this screen. We retain QK-Wanda as the main method; the extensions expose checkpoint-specific tradeoffs rather than a uniformly superior replacement.
blocks.zh: 扩大的比较增加了Llama-2-70B、Llama-3.1-70B和Quen2.5-72B,它们在同一两个垃圾堆上,并评价了所有6个检查站执行同样的7个零镜头任务的情况。 所有96个PPL配置和96个零发配置都是独立验证的,包括兼容的再利用测量. 表31和32报告所有结果。 最低的PPL和最高的零射变体因检查点和痉挛程度不同而不同,因此没有单一的组合主导这个屏幕. 我们保留QK-万达作为主要方法;延期暴露了检查站特有的权衡,而不是统一的优越替代。

blocks.en: Table 32: Eight scoring combinations on 70–72B models: causal mask (M), RoPE (R), and centering (C). QK variants share a QK budget; Wanda uses row-wise budgets. Dense (0%) is repeated as a reference. Avg. is the mean seven-task zero-shot accuracy (%). Bold marks the lowest available PPL among QK variants (displayed ties included). Attention itself is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 表32:70–72B型机车上的8个积分组合:因果口罩(M),ROPE(R),和中心(C). QK变体共享QK预算;万达采用逐行预算. ense(0%)作为参考重复. Avg.是平均七任务零射精度(%). 粗体标出在QK变体中可获得的PPL最低(包含分解关系). 注意本身没有变化。
